ja: シエル: 彼女は、とても優しいところもございますのよ。

key: But there's no surprise there.
en: But there's no surprise there.
ja: まあ、意外なことでもありませんけれど。

key: The three of us were always the perfect team.
en: The three of us were always the perfect team.
ja: わたしたち三人は、いつだって完璧なチームでしたから。

key: Maybe ending up like this was inevitable...
en: Maybe ending up like this was inevitable...
ja: こうなることは、避けられなかったのかもしれませんわね……

key: ...I like to think so.
en: ...I like to think so.
ja: ……そう思いたいですわ。

key: That it was destiny.
en: That it was destiny.
ja: 運命だったのだ、と。

key: CELEBI: Biiiiiiii~
en: CELEBI: Biiiiiiii~
ja: セレビィ: ビィィィィ~

key: Celebi seems very excited by all the celebrations!
en: Celebi seems very excited by all the celebrations!
ja: セレビィは、お祝いの雰囲気にとても興奮しているようだ!

key: FLORINIA: Fascinating...
en: FLORINIA: Fascinating...
ja: フロリニア: 興味深いですね……

key: You travel through time, but do so with a deep connection to the natural world...
en: You travel through time, but do so with a deep connection to the natural world...
ja: 時を超えて旅をするというのに、自然界との深いつながりを持ったまま、それを行うのですね……

key: Grass Type Pokémon are truly wonderous, you are a beautiful creature.
en: Grass Type Pokémon are truly wonderous, you are a beautiful creature.
ja: くさタイプのポケモンは、本当に素晴らしいものです。あなたは美しい生き物ですね。

key: TAKA: I... don't mean to interrupt but...
en: TAKA: I... don't mean to interrupt but...
ja: タカ: その……邪魔するつもりはないんだけど……

key: Is everything okay?
en: Is everything okay?
ja: 大丈夫?

key: I thought I heard crying...
en: I thought I heard crying...
ja: 泣き声が聞こえた気がして……

key: FLORINIA: Oh!
en: FLORINIA: Oh!
ja: フロリニア: あ!

key: Yes, yes, I'm completely okay.
en: Yes, yes, I'm completely okay.
ja: はい、はい、全く問題ありません。

key: I was just admiring this beautiful creature and I got a little emotional is all...
en: I was just admiring this beautiful creature and I got a little emotional is all...
ja: この美しい生き物に見とれていて、少し感情的になってしまっただけです……

key: But you can hardly blame me now, can you?
en: But you can hardly blame me now, can you?
ja: でも、これで責められはしないでしょう?

key: There's so much to be happy about, these days.
en: There's so much to be happy about, these days.
ja: このところ、幸せなことがたくさんありますから。

key: Everyone is happy and doing well, how can that make a person anything other than so full of emotion, they need to cry?
en: Everyone is happy and doing well, how can that make a person anything other than so full of emotion, they need to cry?
ja: みんなが幸せで元気にしていて、それを見て、泣きたくなるほど感情でいっぱいにならずにいられるでしょうか?

key: And then of course the most wonderful news:
en: And then of course the most wonderful news:
ja: それに、もちろん、最も素晴らしい知らせといえば――

key: \PN, Taka!
en: \PN, Taka!
ja: \PN、タカ!

key: You're both alive and well!
en: You're both alive and well!
ja: お二人とも、無事で元気だということです!

key: TAKA: I...
en: TAKA: I...
ja: タカ: 僕……

key: Sorry, you just caught me off guard being so... different.
en: Sorry, you just caught me off guard being so...  different.
ja: ごめん、なんかその……違ってて、驚いちゃって。

key: FLORINIA: Different?
en: FLORINIA: Different?
ja: フロリニア: 違う?

key: I have no idea what you're talking about.
en: I have no idea what you're talking about.
ja: 何のことだか、さっぱりわかりません。

key: I grew my hair out some, but I don't think I've aged so much as to be unrecognizable?
en: I grew my hair out some, but I don't think I've aged so much as to be unrecognizable?
ja: 髪は少し伸ばしましたが、見分けがつかなくなるほど年を取ったとは思いませんが?

key: TAKA: Oh, no, I just meant...
en: TAKA: Oh, no, I just meant...
ja: タカ: あ、いや、僕が言いたかったのは……

key: FLORINIA: Taka, I'm pulling your leg.
en: FLORINIA: Taka, I'm pulling your leg.
ja: フロリニア: タカ、からかっているだけです。

key: The last decade had me doing a lot of introspection.
en: The last decade had me doing a lot of introspection.
ja: この十年間、わたしはずっと内省を続けてきました。

key: A long time ago, I decided I didn't like the person I was,
en: A long time ago, I decided I didn't like the person I was,
ja: ずっと前、わたしは、自分という人間が好きではないと決めたのです。

key: That I was weak and got hurt too easily, and needed to change that.
en: That I was weak and got hurt too easily, and needed to change that.
ja: 弱くて、簡単に傷つきすぎる、それを変える必要があると。

key: But over the last decade?
en: But over the last decade?
ja: けれど、この十年で?

key: I decided I didn't like that new person I had become.
en: I decided I didn't like that new person I had become.
ja: わたしは、自分がなった新しい人間もまた、好きではないと決めたのです。

key: I couldn't put into words that being that way made me feel so hollow.
en: I couldn't put into words that being that way made me feel so hollow.
ja: そのようにあることが、これほど自分を空虚にさせるとは、言葉にできませんでした。

key: And it took a lot of work for me to move past that.
en: And it took a lot of work for me to move past that.
ja: そして、それを乗り越えるには、多くの努力が必要でした。

key: But people cared enough to help me along the way, and, I...
en: But people cared enough to help me along the way, and, I...
ja: けれど、道のりの中で、助けてくれるほど気にかけてくれる人たちがいて、わたしは……

key: Well...
en: Well...
ja: その……

key: CELEBI: Biiiii?
en: CELEBI: Biiiii?
ja: セレビィ: ビィィ?

key: FLORINIA: Thank you, little Pokémon.
en: FLORINIA: Thank you, little Pokémon.
ja: フロリニア: ありがとう、小さなポケモンさん。

key: Just thinking about how much everyone cared, I couldn't help but tear up again.
en: Just thinking about how much everyone cared, I couldn't help but tear up again.
ja: みんながどれほど気にかけてくれていたかを考えるだけで、また涙が出てしまいました。

key: But it's good tears, I promise, no need to be worried.
en: But it's good tears, I promise, no need to be worried.
ja: でも、これはうれしい涙です、約束します、心配なさらないでください。

key: CELEBI: Biiii!
en: CELEBI: Biiii!
ja: セレビィ: ビィ!

key: FLORINIA: Now, where was I...?
en: FLORINIA: Now, where was I...?
ja: フロリニア: それで、どこまで話しましたか……?

key: TAKA: Ah, you were just telling us about how much things have changed for you...
en: TAKA: Ah, you were just telling us about how much things have changed for you...
ja: タカ: ああ、フロリニアにとってどれだけ物事が変わったか、話してくれてたところだよ……

key: FLORINIA: Right, of course I was.
en: FLORINIA: Right, of course I was.
ja: フロリニア: そうでした、もちろんそうです。

key: So much has changed, and Shelly has done a wonderful job.
en: So much has changed, and Shelly has done a wonderful job.
ja: 本当に多くのことが変わりましたし、シェリーは素晴らしい仕事をしてくれました。

key: I helped her with a lot of her studies, but that time feels fleeting,
en: I helped her with a lot of her studies, but that time feels fleeting,
ja: 彼女の勉強をたくさん手伝いましたが、あの時間はあっという間に感じられます。

key: Given how rapidly she managed to eclipse me.
en: Given how rapidly she managed to eclipse me.
ja: 彼女があっという間にわたしを追い越してしまったことを考えると。

key: Of course, everybody has helped Shelly in one way or another to get Reborn to where it is today.
en: Of course, everybody has helped Shelly in one way or another to get Reborn to where it is today.
ja: もちろん、リボーンを今の姿にするために、誰もが何らかの形でシェリーを助けてきました。

key: But the real beauty of it?
en: But the real beauty of it?
ja: でも、本当に美しいのは?

key: I think she's helped us all too, to grow and realize our best selves.
en: I think she's helped us all too, to grow and realize our best selves.
ja: 彼女はわたしたち全員が成長し、最高の自分に気づく手助けもしてくれたのだと思います。

key: Of all the times you could have been brought to by Celebi, I'm glad it was this one.
en: Of all the times you could have been brought to by Celebi, I'm glad it was this one.
ja: セレビィがあなたを連れてくることのできた、あらゆる時の中で、この時でよかったと思います。

key: Because it's such a wonderful time to behold.
en: Because it's such a wonderful time to behold.
ja: 目にするには、本当に素晴らしい時代ですから。

key: I hope both of you remember this when you return to your time.
en: I hope both of you remember this when you return to your time.
ja: お二人が自分たちの時代に戻った時、これを覚えていてくださるといいのですが。

key: Strive to make everyone in Reborn as happy as we are now--
en: Strive to make everyone in Reborn as happy as we are now--
ja: リボーンのみんなが、今のわたしたちと同じくらい幸せになれるよう、努めてください――

key: Or even happier!
en: Or even happier!
ja: いえ、もっと幸せに!

key: TAKA: You have such a positive outlook...
en: TAKA: You have such a positive outlook...
ja: タカ: すごく前向きなんだね……

key: I can't help but want to do my part when we get back.
en: I can't help but want to do my part when we get back.
ja: 戻ったら、自分の役割を果たしたいって思わずにいられないよ。

key: You can count on us.
en: You can count on us.
ja: 僕たちに任せて。

key: And Celebi too, right?
en: And Celebi too, right?
ja: セレビィもね?

key: ELIAS: Legendary Pokémon truly are wonderful, yes.
en: ELIAS: Legendary Pokémon truly are wonderful, yes.
ja: イライアス: 伝説のポケモンとは、まことに素晴らしいものですな、ええ。

key: I do hope I'm not interrupting, but I thought I heard crying?
en: I do hope I'm not interrupting, but I thought I heard crying?
ja: 邪魔をしていなければよいのですが、泣き声が聞こえたような気がして?

key: Is Celebi all right?
en: Is Celebi all right?
ja: セレビィは大丈夫ですか?

key: Yes, yes, we're both completely okay.
en: Yes, yes, we're both completely okay.
ja: はい、はい、二人とも全く問題ありません。

key: \PN, Elias!
en: \PN, Elias!
ja: \PN、イライアス!

key: ELIAS: The crying was you?
en: ELIAS: The crying was you?
ja: イライアス: 泣いていたのは、あなたでしたか?

key: Even tears of joy that is...
en: Even tears of joy that is...
ja: 喜びの涙だとしても……

key: Unexpected.
en: Unexpected.
ja: 意外ですな。

key: Although I suppose everyone is likely to be very different after ten years.
en: Although I suppose everyone is likely to be very different after ten years.
ja: もっとも、十年も経てば、誰もがずいぶん変わっているものでしょうが。

key: ELIAS: Your aesthetic is not exactly what I was referring to...
en: ELIAS: Your aesthetic is not exactly what I was referring to...
ja: イライアス: わたしが申し上げていたのは、見た目のことではなく……

key: FLORINIA: Elias, I'm pulling your leg.
en: FLORINIA: Elias, I'm pulling your leg.
ja: フロリニア: イライアス、からかっているだけです。

key: ELIAS: You were rather eloquently explaining to us how much things have changed.
en: ELIAS: You were rather eloquently explaining to us how much things have changed.
ja: イライアス: あなたは、物事がどれほど変わったかを、実に雄弁に説明してくださっていましたな。

key: ELIAS: I must admit, when we approached you, I think the last thing I expected,
en: ELIAS: I must admit, when we approached you, I think the last thing I expected,
ja: イライアス: 白状しますと、我々があなたに近づいた時、最も予想していなかったのは、

key: Was that your joy would be quite so contagious that I'd hardly be able to stop smiling.
en: Was that your joy would be quite so contagious that I'd hardly be able to stop smiling.
ja: まさか、あなたの喜びがこれほど伝染して、笑いが止まらなくなるとは、思ってもみませんでした。

key: I think Celebi feels the same.
en: I think Celebi feels the same.
ja: セレビィも同じように感じていると思います。

key: ELIAS: But regardless; I have always strived to do what is best for Reborn.
en: ELIAS: But regardless; I have always strived to do what is best for Reborn.
ja: イライアス: とはいえ、わたしは常に、リボーンにとって最善のことを行うよう努めてまいりました。

key: And you have my assurance I will continue.
en: And you have my assurance I will continue.
ja: そして、これからもそうし続けることを、お約束いたします。

key: And now I have the guidance of my Lord beside me, I shall not stray down false paths to this as I once did...
en: And now I have the guidance of my Lord beside me, I shall not stray down false paths to this as I once did...
ja: そして今、我が主のお導きが傍らにある以上、かつてのように誤った道へ迷い込むことはございません……

key: FLORINIA: Well, I'm looking forward to seeing what your timeline is like in ten years, then.
en: FLORINIA: Well, I'm looking forward to seeing what your timeline is like in ten years, then.
ja: フロリニア: それでは、十年後のあなたの時代がどうなっているか、楽しみにしていますね。

key: Or rather, the version of me that's in it is, even if she doesn't know it yet.
en: Or rather, the version of me that's in it is, even if she doesn't know it yet.
ja: というより、その時代の中にいるわたし自身が、ですね。まだ本人は知らないでしょうけれど。

key: I have every faith in you both that you'll do wonderful things.
en: I have every faith in you both that you'll do wonderful things.
ja: お二人が素晴らしいことを成し遂げてくれると、心から信じています。

key: FLORINIA: Just seeing how much work everyone has put in to come together to see you again, \PN...
en: FLORINIA: Just seeing how much work everyone has put in to come together to see you again, \PN...
ja: フロリニア: あなたにまた会うために、みんながどれだけの労力を注いでくれたかを見るだけで、\PN……

key: It's enough to make you cry!
en: It's enough to make you cry!
ja: 泣けてしまうほどです!

key: Somebody baked a huge amount of brownies for everyone at the cafe!
en: Somebody baked a huge amount of brownies for everyone at the cafe!
ja: 誰かが、カフェのみんなのために、大量のブラウニーを焼いてくれたのです!

key: They're not very good,
en: They're not very good,
ja: あまり美味しくはありませんが、

key: In fact, they're terrible.
en: In fact, they're terrible.
ja: 実のところ、ひどい出来です。

key: But does that really matter?
en: But does that really matter?
ja: でも、それは本当に大事なことでしょうか?

key: It's lovely they put in all that work.
en: It's lovely they put in all that work.
ja: その労力を注いでくれたことが、素敵なのです。

key: Doing something terribly is the first step on the road to doing something well, after all.
en: Doing something terribly is the first step on the road to doing something well, after all.
ja: 結局、何かをひどい出来でやってみることこそ、上手にできるようになる道の第一歩なのですから。

key: Be like whoever made those awful, inedible brownies:
en: Be like whoever made those awful, inedible brownies:
ja: あのひどい、食べられないブラウニーを作った誰かのようになってください。

key: No matter how catastrophically you mess up, keep trying and share what you've done with those you love, anyway.
en: No matter how catastrophically you mess up, keep trying and share what you've done with those you love, anyway.
ja: どれほど壊滅的に失敗しても、挑戦し続け、それでもなお、成し遂げたものを愛する人たちと分かち合ってください。

key: FERN: Hey, glad you have a moment.
en: FERN: Hey, glad you have a moment.
ja: ファーン: よお、時間あってよかった。

key: I wanted to say...
en: I wanted to say...
ja: 言いたいことがあってさ……

key: I resented you, deeply, for so long.
en: I resented you, deeply, for so long.
ja: 長い間、お前のこと、心底恨んでた。

key: I always felt like you were in the way.
en: I always felt like you were in the way.
ja: いつも、お前が邪魔だって感じてたんだ。

key: Like, somehow, your presence was stopping me from being the best I could.
en: Like, somehow, your presence was stopping me from being the best I could.
ja: 何て言うか、お前がいるだけで、オレが一番になれない気がしてたんだ。

key: I felt like the brightest candle in the world being put next to an industrial lightbulb.
en: I felt like the brightest candle in the world being put next to an industrial lightbulb.
ja: 世界一明るいろうそくのつもりが、工業用の電球の隣に置かれたみたいな気分だったぜ。

key: And here we are;
en: And here we are;
ja: で、今がこれだ。

key: You vanish for ten years and now I'm the second- best trainer in Reborn.
en: You vanish for ten years and now I'm the second- best trainer in Reborn.
ja: お前が10年も消えちまって、今やオレはリボーンで二番目に強いトレーナーだ。

key: Given the league's reputation, maybe in the whole world.
en: Given the league's reputation, maybe in the whole world.
ja: リーグの評判を考えりゃ、世界でも二番目かもな。

key: And even knowing how completely outclassed I am by Shelly, it didn't feel the same as when it was you.
en: And even knowing how completely outclassed I am by Shelly, it didn't feel the same as when it was you.
ja: シェリーに完全に負けてるって分かってても、お前の時とは違う気分だったんだよな。

key: And yet?
en: And yet?
ja: それなのに?

key: It's felt hollow; like something was missing.
en: It's felt hollow; like something was missing.
ja: 何か空っぽで、足りないもんがある感じがしてた。

key: I'm glad you're back.
en: I'm glad you're back.
ja: お前が戻ってきてうれしいぜ。

key: HARDY: You know I really don't like that you two just,
en: HARDY: You know I really don't like that you two just,
ja: ハーディ: 正直、お前ら二人が最近さ、

key: Hang out now?
en: Hang out now?
ja: つるんでんの気に入らねえんだよな?

key: HARDY: Oh, perfect, company to save me from this nightmare.
en: HARDY: Oh, perfect, company to save me from this nightmare.
ja: ハーディ: おっ、ちょうどいい、この悪夢から救ってくれる連れが来たぜ。

key: \PN, Elias. Hey.
en: \PN, Elias. Hey.
ja: \PN、イライアス。よう。

key: \PN, Taka. Hey.
en: \PN, Taka. Hey.
ja: \PN、タカ。よう。

key: Good to see you both back.
en: Good to see you both back.
ja: 二人とも戻ってきて何よりだ。

key: TITANIA: Welcome back.
en: TITANIA: Welcome back.
ja: ティタニア: おかえり。

key: FERN: Sup.
en: FERN: Sup.
ja: ファーン: よう。

key: TAKA: Hey, uh...
en: TAKA: Hey, uh...
ja: タカ: あの、えっと……

key: TITANIA: Speak up.
en: TITANIA: Speak up.
ja: ティタニア: ちゃんとしゃべりな。

key: And stop looking down at your shoes.
en: And stop looking down at your shoes.
ja: 靴なんか見てないでさ。

key: It's been long enough that you should've grown a spine by now.
en: It's been long enough that you should've grown a spine by now.
ja: もう十分な時間が経ったんだから、根性の一つも身についてるはずだろ。

key: TAKA: That's...
en: TAKA: That's...
ja: タカ: それは……

key: TITANIA: Ha, you're way too highly strung.
en: TITANIA: Ha, you're way too highly strung.
ja: ティタニア: ハッ、相変わらず緊張しすぎ。

key: I know even though it's been 10 years for me, it's been like, what,
en: I know even though it's been 10 years for me, it's been like, what,
ja: あたしにとっちゃ10年経ってるけど、あんたらにとっちゃ何、

key: Not even a day for you since you two disappeared?
en: Not even a day for you since you two disappeared?
ja: 消えてから1日も経ってないんだろ?

key: Growing out of old habits takes time.
en: Growing out of old habits takes time.
ja: 古い癖が抜けるには時間がかかるもんさ。

key: You'll get there, I'm just giving you shit.
en: You'll get there, I'm just giving you shit.
ja: そのうち慣れるって。ちょっとからかっただけ。

key: TAKA: ...Thanks.
en: TAKA: ...Thanks.
ja: タカ: ……ありがとう。

key: I think?
en: I think?
ja: たぶん?

key: And... thanks again for at the Water Treatment Center all those years ago.
en: And... thanks again for at the Water Treatment Center all those years ago.
ja: それと……昔、浄水施設でのことも改めてありがとう。

key: Even if I didn't listen to you at the time, I...
en: Even if I didn't listen to you at the time, I...
ja: あの時は言うこと聞かなかったけど、僕……

key: You actually tried to look out for me.
en: You actually tried to look out for me.
ja: 本当に僕のことを気にかけてくれてたんだよね。

key: ...Even if you were a lot scarier about it back then.
en: ...Even if you were a lot scarier about it back then.
ja: ……あの頃はもっと怖かったけど。

key: FERN: She's still plenty scary, just didn't bring her stabbing Aegislash to the party.
en: FERN: She's still plenty scary, just didn't bring her stabbing Aegislash to the party.
ja: ファーン: 今でも十分怖えよ、パーティーに刺し殺し要員のギルガルドを連れてきてないだけで。

key: She's not the only one that's changed though;
en: She's not the only one that's changed though;
ja: 変わったのはあいつだけじゃねえけどな。

key: Notice anything else?
en: Notice anything else?
ja: 他に何か気付かねえか?

key: HARDY: Not this again...
en: HARDY: Not this again...
ja: ハーディ: またこれかよ……

key: TAKA: I mean, you've all changed your hair?
en: TAKA: I mean, you've all changed your hair?
ja: タカ: えっと、みんな髪型変わった?

key: FERN: Yeah, and we look great.
en: FERN: Yeah, and we look great.
ja: ファーン: ああ、しかもオレ様ら最高にキマってるだろ。

key: But I was talking about mister rockstar.
en: But I was talking about mister rockstar.
ja: でもオレが言ってたのはロックスター様のことだぜ。

en: He doesn't try and fake his voice to sound like what he thinks is 'cool' anymore.
ja: もう「イケてる」つもりの作り声でしゃべらなくなったんだ。

en: Yanno, like, y'all've gotta remember he'd say rockin' stuff 'n shit, mate?
ja: ほら、あれだよ、「イケてるぜ、相棒」みたいなこと言ってたの覚えてるだろ?

en: HARDY: For the last time.
ja: ハーディ: もう何度も言ってるけどな。

en: I never sounded like that.
ja: オレはそんなしゃべり方してなかったぜ。

en: TITANIA: Fern, we've spoken about this.
ja: ティタニア: ファーン、その話は前にもしたろ。

ja: あんたはもう立派なリボーンリーグの一員なんだから。

key: You need to conduct yourself properly.
en: You need to conduct yourself properly.
ja: ちゃんとした振る舞いをしなきゃ。

en: Doing a bad impression of one of the region's most famous musicians is unbecoming.
ja: この地方で一番有名なミュージシャンの下手な物真似なんて、みっともないよ。

key: HARDY: ...

ja: ハーディ: ……

key: TITANIA: Ahem.
en: TITANIA: Ahem.
ja: ティタニア: んん。

key: You need to give things your all now.
en: You need to give things your all now.
ja: 今度は本気でやんな。

key: Make it a GOOD impression.
en: Make it a GOOD impression.
ja: ちゃんとした物真似をするんだよ。

key: Short sentences.
en: Short sentences.
ja: 短いセンテンスで。

key: Chill vibes.
en: Chill vibes.
ja: チルな感じで。

key: Don't overthink, mate.
en: Don't overthink, mate.
ja: 考えすぎるなよ、相棒。

key: Just go with the flow, yanno?
en: Just go with the flow, yanno?
ja: 流れに身を任せろよな?

key: Feel the music, and rock on.
en: Feel the music, and rock on.
ja: 音楽を感じて、ロックしようぜ。

key: Maybe roll out a pun or two just to lay it on real thick, aye?
en: Maybe roll out a pun or two just to lay it on real thick, aye?
ja: ダジャレの一つや二つ、思いっきりぶちかましてやれよ、なあ?

key: HARDY: I cannot overstate how much I hate this.
en: HARDY: I cannot overstate how much I hate this.
ja: ハーディ: これがどれだけ嫌か、言葉じゃ言い表せねえ。

key: TAKA: ...I'm glad you all seem to be getting along.
en: TAKA: ...I'm glad you all seem to be getting along.
ja: タカ: ……みんな仲良さそうで良かった。

key: You said something about Fern being a serious member of the League?
en: You said something about Fern being a serious member of the League?
ja: ファーンがリーグの立派な一員になったって?

key: Is he a Gym Leader now?
en: Is he a Gym Leader now?
ja: ジムリーダーにでもなったの?

key: HARDY: If only.
en: HARDY: If only.
ja: ハーディ: それだったらまだマシだぜ。

key: Somehow, standing in front of me is half of this region's Elite Four.
en: Somehow, standing in front of me is half of this region's Elite Four.
ja: どういうわけか、オレの目の前にいるのは、この地方の四天王の半分だ。

key: TAKA: Oh, wow uh...
en: TAKA: Oh, wow uh...
ja: タカ: え、すごい、えっと……

key: Congratulations.
en: Congratulations.
ja: おめでとう。

key: I mean, I've seen you both be pretty incredible in battle so...
en: I mean, I've seen you both be pretty incredible in battle so...
ja: いや、二人とも戦いですごいところ見てきたし……

key: ...Yeah...
en: ...Yeah...

key: FERN: Hardy's still pouting that we both surpassed him.
en: FERN: Hardy's still pouting that we both surpassed him.
ja: ファーン: ハーディはオレ様らに追い越されて未だにふてくされてんだよな。

key: You'd think he'd be content being an actual rockstar now.
en: You'd think he'd be content being an actual rockstar now.
ja: 本物のロックスターになったんだから満足しろって話だけどな。

key: TITANIA: Guess you don't need to fake sounding successful when you actually are, huh?
en: TITANIA: Guess you don't need to fake sounding successful when you actually are, huh?
ja: ティタニア: 本当に成功してりゃ、成功してるふりする必要もないってことか?

key: HARDY: You know even when you two compliment me, it still feels mean.
en: HARDY: You know even when you two compliment me, it still feels mean.
ja: ハーディ: お前らが褒めてる時でも、なんか嫌味に聞こえるんだよな。

key: I was actually happy for you both, you know.
en: I was actually happy for you both, you know.
ja: 本当に二人のことうれしく思ってたんだぜ。

key: You worked real hard.
en: You worked real hard.
ja: ちゃんと頑張ってたもんな。

key: Sis, you've always been terrifying in a battle.
en: Sis, you've always been terrifying in a battle.
ja: 姉貴はずっとバトルで恐ろしかったし。

key: And Fern, I mean, took you a while to figure out how to make people wanna be around you.
en: And Fern, I mean, took you a while to figure out how to make people wanna be around you.
ja: ファーンは、まあ、人に好かれる方法を身につけるまで時間かかったけどな。

en: The bit I'm 'pouting' about,
ja: オレが「ふてくされてる」のはさ、

key: Is that you both got the job, and so you ended up hanging out.
en: Is that you both got the job, and so you ended up hanging out.
ja: 二人が同じ仕事に就いて、つるむようになったってところだぜ。

key: And now I have to deal with a united front mocking me.
en: And now I have to deal with a united front mocking me.
ja: おかげでオレは団結してからかってくる二人を相手にする羽目になってる。

key: ...But nah, I'm happy for you guys.
en: ...But nah, I'm happy for you guys.
ja: ……でもまあ、お前らのことはうれしいぜ。

key: And all the teasing aside, it is nice to actually be able to talk to either of you,
en: And all the teasing aside, it is nice to actually be able to talk to either of you,
ja: からかい合いは置いといて、お前ら二人とちゃんと話せるのはうれしいことだ、

key: Y'know, without being at each other's throats.
en: Y'know, without being at each other's throats.
ja: ほら、いちいちけんか腰にならずにさ。

key: FERN: Likewise.
en: FERN: Likewise.
ja: ファーン: オレ様も同感だぜ。

key: Elite Four... It's pretty cool stuff, really.
en: Elite Four... It's pretty cool stuff, really.
ja: 四天王、か……マジでイケてるよな。

key: TITANIA: Shelly's a good kid.
en: TITANIA: Shelly's a good kid.
ja: ティタニア: シェリーはいい子だよ。

key: I tried to take her under my wing, but she rubbed off on me as much as I did on her.
en: I tried to take her under my wing, but she rubbed off on me as much as I did on her.
ja: 面倒見てやろうと思ってたけど、あたしがあの子に影響与えた分、あたしもあの子から影響受けちまった。

key: So I jumped at the chance to be one of her Elite Four.
en: So I jumped at the chance to be one of her Elite Four.
ja: だからあの子の四天王になる話には飛びついたのさ。

key: TAKA: Oh, yeah.
en: TAKA: Oh, yeah.
ja: タカ: ああ、そういえば。

key: The influence was pretty obvious when we met her.
en: The influence was pretty obvious when we met her.
ja: 会った時、その影響がはっきり分かったよ。

key: Walking through her room at the league, I was pretty certain it was gonna be you.
en: Walking through her room at the league, I was pretty certain it was gonna be you.
ja: リーグの部屋を歩いた時、絶対ティタニアの部屋だと思ったもん。

key: TITANIA: The swords were her idea!
en: TITANIA: The swords were her idea!
ja: ティタニア: 剣はあの子のアイデアだよ!

key: HARDY: Shelly is a great Champion.
en: HARDY: Shelly is a great Champion.
ja: ハーディ: シェリーはすごいチャンピオンだぜ。

key: No offense to you, obviously, \PN.
en: No offense to you, obviously, \PN.
ja: もちろん\PNに悪気はないけどな。

key: But anyone that can mellow out these two is hard to beat in my book.
en: But anyone that can mellow out these two is hard to beat in my book.
ja: でもこの二人を丸くできるやつなんて、オレの中じゃそうそういねえよ。

key: TAKA: I'm glad you guys all seem to be doing well.
en: TAKA: I'm glad you guys all seem to be doing well.
ja: タカ: みんな元気そうで良かった。

key: And congrats on both making Elite Four.
en: And congrats on both making Elite Four.
ja: 二人とも四天王おめでとう。

key: And for your music Hardy...
en: And for your music Hardy...
ja: それとハーディの音楽も……

key: Yanno, mate?
en: Yanno, mate?
ja: な、相棒?

key: HARDY: ...I remember back when I wished my sister was more friendly.
en: HARDY: ...I remember back when I wished my sister was more friendly.
ja: ハーディ: ……昔、姉貴がもっと愛想良けりゃなって思ってた頃を思い出すぜ。

key: If only I knew.
en: If only I knew.
ja: 知らない方が良かったな。

key: The blissful ignorance of those days...
en: The blissful ignorance of those days...
ja: あの頃の幸せな無知よ……

key: ELIAS: Ah, hello.
en: ELIAS: Ah, hello.
ja: イライアス: ああ、こんにちは。

key: TITANIA: Hey, you.
en: TITANIA: Hey, you.
ja: ティタニア: よう、あんた。

key: I got a good look at your room in the League after you vanished.
en: I got a good look at your room in the League after you vanished.
ja: あんたが消えた後、リーグにあった部屋、じっくり見せてもらったよ。

key: It was incredibly intricate.
en: It was incredibly intricate.
ja: めちゃくちゃ凝ってたね。

key: Beautiful too; must've taken a lot of work to get it to your specifications.
en: Beautiful too; must've taken a lot of work to get it to your specifications.
ja: 美しかったし。あんたの注文通りにするのに相当な手間がかかったろうね。

key: ELIAS: That's...
en: ELIAS: That's...
ja: イライアス: それは……

key: Yes, actually!
en: Yes, actually!
ja: ええ、実際そうです!

key: I do love good architecture, so I made sure--
en: I do love good architecture, so I made sure--
ja: 私は建築が好きなので、必ず――

key: TITANIA: I'm Elite Four now.
en: TITANIA: I'm Elite Four now.
ja: ティタニア: あたしは今四天王でね。

key: They gave me your room.
en: They gave me your room.
ja: あんたの部屋、あたしがもらったんだ。

key: I tore it all down.
en: I tore it all down.
ja: 全部ぶっ壊してやったよ。

key: ELIAS: I...
en: ELIAS: I...
ja: イライアス: 私は……

key: TITANIA: They just put everything for it in storage.
en: TITANIA: They just put everything for it in storage.
ja: ティタニア: 中の物は倉庫にしまい込んどいたよ。

key: But that look on your face was pretty cathartic.
en: But that look on your face was pretty cathartic.
ja: でも今のその顔、見れて結構スッキリしたね。

en: That feels like as much payback as I can get with my Aegislash at home.
ja: ギルガルドを家に置いてきたあたしにできる仕返しなんて、これくらいのもんさ。

en: Either of you two want a turn?
ja: あんたらもやりたい?

key: HARDY: Nah, I'm good.
en: HARDY: Nah, I'm good.
ja: ハーディ: いや、いいぜ。

en: I already got Bennett back years ago, going again would feel like a repeat.
ja: ベネットへの仕返しはもう何年も前に済ませたし、また同じことするのは芸がねえ。

key: FERN: I feel like I'm probably on the wrong side of all this to want payback against him.
en: FERN: I feel like I'm probably on the wrong side of all this to want payback against him.
ja: ファーン: オレ様は多分あいつに仕返ししたい側じゃなくて、される側だからな。

key: TITANIA: Suit yourselves.
en: TITANIA: Suit yourselves.
ja: ティタニア: 好きにしな。

key: ELIAS: ...You know, when we first entered the Champion's room at the league, I thought it was you.
en: ELIAS: ...You know, when we first entered the Champion's room at the league, I thought it was you.
ja: イライアス: ……そういえば、リーグで初めてチャンピオンの部屋に入った時、あなたの部屋かと思いました。

key: And I feared for my life.
en: And I feared for my life.
ja: 命の危険を感じましたよ。

key: So I suppose I've gotten off easy.
en: So I suppose I've gotten off easy.
ja: ということは、まだ軽く済んだ方のようですね。

key: Perhaps I had no reason to be so scared.
en: Perhaps I had no reason to be so scared.
ja: あれほど怖がる理由はなかったのかもしれません。

key: FERN: She's still plenty scary, it's just like she said,
en: FERN: She's still plenty scary, it's just like she said,
ja: ファーン: 今でも十分怖えよ、あいつが言った通り、

key: She just didn't bring her stabbing Aegislash to the party.
en: She just didn't bring her stabbing Aegislash to the party.
ja: 刺し殺し要員のギルガルドを連れてきてないだけでな。

key: She's not the only one that's changed though; notice anything else?
en: She's not the only one that's changed though; notice anything else?
ja: 変わったのはあいつだけじゃねえけど、他に何か気付かねえか?

key: ELIAS: It's been ten years, you all look remarkably different.
en: ELIAS: It's been ten years, you all look remarkably different.
ja: イライアス: 十年も経てば、皆さんずいぶん様子が変わって見えます。

key: And I can't say I knew any of you very well beforehand.
en: And I can't say I knew any of you very well beforehand.
ja: もっとも、以前からそれほどよく知っていたわけでもありませんが。

key: FERN: Yeah, we all look different, sure.
en: FERN: Yeah, we all look different, sure.
ja: ファーン: ああ、そりゃ見た目は変わったぜ、確かに。

key: Look great, in fact.
en: Look great, in fact.
ja: 実際、最高にキマってるしな。

key: ELIAS: You all seem to be very close friends.
en: ELIAS: You all seem to be very close friends.
ja: イライアス: 皆さんとても仲がよろしいようですね。

key: What is this about Fern being a serious member of the League?
en: What is this about Fern being a serious member of the League?
ja: ファーンがリーグの立派な一員というのは、どういうことでしょう?

key: ELIAS: Goodness, Fern as well?
en: ELIAS: Goodness, Fern as well?
ja: イライアス: これは、ファーンさんもですか?

key: I am certainly aware of your battle prowess from even ten years ago.
en: I am certainly aware of your battle prowess from even ten years ago.
ja: 十年前からあなたの戦闘の腕前は存じ上げています。

key: Reborn seems to be in very good hands, with such a strong Elite Four and Champion.
en: Reborn seems to be in very good hands, with such a strong Elite Four and Champion.
ja: これほど強力な四天王とチャンピオンがいれば、リボーンは安泰のようですね。

key: The bit I'm 'pouting' about.
en: The bit I'm 'pouting' about.
ja: オレが「ふてくされてる」のはさ。

key: Is that you both got the job, and so ended up hanging out.
en: Is that you both got the job, and so ended up hanging out.
ja: 二人が同じ仕事に就いて、つるむようになったってところだぜ。

key: HARDY: Yeah, Shelly is a great Champion.
en: HARDY: Yeah, Shelly is a great Champion.
ja: ハーディ: ああ、シェリーはすごいチャンピオンだぜ。

key: ELIAS: She certainly appears to be doing very well, from what we saw.
en: ELIAS: She certainly appears to be doing very well, from what we saw.
ja: イライアス: 私たちが見た限りでも、とてもうまくやっているようでした。

key: HARDY: Yeah, things are going pretty well.
en: HARDY: Yeah, things are going pretty well.
ja: ハーディ: ああ、色々うまくいってるぜ。

key: I'm sure they'll go just as great back in your time, too.
en: I'm sure they'll go just as great back in your time, too.
ja: お前らの時代でも同じくらいうまくいくはずだぜ。

key: TITANIA: Y'know, I thought I'd quit battling altogether after everything with Meteor.
en: TITANIA: Y'know, I thought I'd quit battling altogether after everything with Meteor.
ja: ティタニア: メテオの一件があった後、バトルなんてもう全部やめようと思ってたんだ。

key: Maybe in another life I would've.
en: Maybe in another life I would've.
ja: 別の人生だったらそうしてたかもね。

key: But I'm pretty damn great at it, and Shelly is worth supporting.
en: But I'm pretty damn great at it, and Shelly is worth supporting.
ja: でもあたしはバトルがめちゃくちゃ得意だし、シェリーは支える価値のある子だからさ。

key: I digress.
en: I digress.
ja: 話が逸れたね。

key: Good luck back in your time.
en: Good luck back in your time.
ja: あんたの時代でも頑張りな。

key: Even if you're only ten percent as good of a Champion as Shelly has turned out to be?
en: Even if you're only ten percent as good of a Champion as Shelly has turned out to be?
ja: シェリーの十分の一くらいのチャンピオンにでもなれれば、

key: Then Reborn is in good hands.
en: Then Reborn is in good hands.
ja: リボーンは安泰さ。

key: HARDY: I know I'm speaking to the person that just had an adventure through time.
en: HARDY: I know I'm speaking to the person that just had an adventure through time.
ja: ハーディ: お前は今時間旅行の冒険を終えたばかりだって分かってるけどな。

key: But my life has been pretty hectic.
en: But my life has been pretty hectic.
ja: オレの人生もなかなか慌ただしかったぜ。

key: Music gigs, traveling around the world...
en: Music gigs, traveling around the world...
ja: ライブに世界中を回ったり……

key: It's pretty cool stuff.
en: It's pretty cool stuff.
ja: なかなかイケてる話だろ。

key: Helps that Aya's always with me the whole time.
en: Helps that Aya's always with me the whole time.
ja: アヤがずっと一緒にいてくれるのも大きいけどな。

key: ...Things are pretty great, really.
en: ...Things are pretty great, really.
ja: ……マジで、色々うまくいってるぜ。

key: But we all missed you, I'm glad you made it back.
en: But we all missed you, I'm glad you made it back.
ja: でもみんなお前がいなくて寂しかったんだ、戻ってきてくれてうれしいぜ。

key: ADRIENN: You know, when Victoria stopped helping out at the Grand Hall to focus on Apophyll,
en: ADRIENN: You know, when Victoria stopped helping out at the Grand Hall to focus on Apophyll,
ja: アドリエンヌ: ヴィクトリアがアポフィルに専念するためにグランドホールの手伝いをやめた時ね、

key: While we were still dealing with the New World aftermath?
en: While we were still dealing with the New World aftermath?
ja: まだニューワールドの後始末に追われてる最中だったのに?

key: I thought I was going to drown in paperwork.
en: I thought I was going to drown in paperwork.
ja: 書類の山に埋もれて溺れるかと思ったわ。

key: But everyone helped out, and these days I can actually even relax!
en: But everyone helped out, and these days I can actually even relax!
ja: でもみんなが手伝ってくれて、今ではちゃんと息抜きもできるようになったの!

key: Seriously, though, are you okay?
en: Seriously, though, are you okay?
ja: でも本当に、大丈夫?

key: Being flung into the future is pretty rough, I get it.
en: Being flung into the future is pretty rough, I get it.
ja: 未来に飛ばされるなんて大変だったでしょう、分かるわ。

key: I used to wish I could go back...
en: I used to wish I could go back...
ja: わたしも昔に戻れたらってよく思ってた……

key: Sometimes I still do.
en: Sometimes I still do.
ja: 今でも時々そう思うわ。

key: But mostly, I'm glad that I've made a life for myself here.
en: But mostly, I'm glad that I've made a life for myself here.
ja: でも大抵は、ここで自分の人生を築けたことをうれしく思ってるの。

key: I'm happy you get to go back to your time, though.
en: I'm happy you get to go back to your time, though.
ja: でもあなたが自分の時代に戻れるのはうれしいわ。

key: Treasure the next ten years you get to spend with everyone.
en: Treasure the next ten years you get to spend with everyone.
ja: みんなと過ごすこれからの十年を大切にしてね。

key: And, like I said, be the best Champion Reborn has ever seen.
en: And, like I said, be the best Champion Reborn has ever seen.
ja: それと、さっきも言った通り、リボーン史上最高のチャンピオンになりなさい。

key: ARCLIGHT: Hey, great to see you two!
en: ARCLIGHT: Hey, great to see you two!
ja: アークライト: よう、二人とも会えてうれしいぜ!

key: They're out of tea, and the brownies are terrible.
en: They're out of tea, and the brownies are terrible.
ja: 紅茶は切れてるし、ブラウニーもひどい味だけどな。

key: But this café is still pretty cool.
en: But this café is still pretty cool.
ja: でもこのカフェはやっぱりいい感じだぜ。

key: And you even get to witness something marvelous, something you'd never see back in your own time:
en: And you even get to witness something marvelous, something you'd never see back in your own time:
ja: それにお前らは今、自分の時代じゃ絶対見られないすごいものを目撃できるんだ。

key: Xyr Majesty, Monarch of Monotony, Archon of Administration.
en: Xyr Majesty, Monarch of Monotony, Archon of Administration.
ja: 単調の君主にして行政の執政官、その陛下、

key: Adrienn sitting down and taking a break.
en: Adrienn sitting down and taking a break.
ja: アドリエンヌが腰を下ろして休憩してる姿をな。

key: ADRIENN: Arc, come on.
en: ADRIENN: Arc, come on.
ja: アドリエンヌ: アーク、もう。

key: I was never that bad, I took breaks.
en: I was never that bad, I took breaks.
ja: そこまでひどくなかったわ、ちゃんと休憩は取ってたもの。

key: I mean, when people made me, at least...
en: I mean, when people made me, at least...
ja: まあ、少なくとも人に無理やり休まされた時は……

key: TAKA: Seems like you're a lot less stressed out, now...
en: TAKA: Seems like you're a lot less stressed out, now...
ja: タカ: 前よりずっとストレス少なそうだね……

key: ADRIENN: Well, having such a brilliant and proactive Champion helps.
en: ADRIENN: Well, having such a brilliant and proactive Champion helps.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そうね、あんなに優秀で行動的なチャンピオンがいてくれると助かるもの。

key: I'm sure I'd be just as relaxed after ten years of \PN as Champion, too.
en: I'm sure I'd be just as relaxed after ten years of \PN as Champion, too.
ja: \PNが十年チャンピオンをやってくれれば、わたしも同じくらいのんびりできるはずよ。

key: ARCLIGHT: Helps that you stopped trying to do about twenty people's jobs at once, too, and learned to actually delegate.
en: ARCLIGHT: Helps that you stopped trying to do about twenty people's jobs at once, too, and learned to actually delegate.
ja: アークライト: 二十人分の仕事を一人で抱え込むのをやめて、ちゃんと人に任せられるようになったのも大きいけどな。

key: ADRIENN: I can't exactly take credit for that with you right here.
en: ADRIENN: I can't exactly take credit for that with you right here.
ja: アドリエンヌ: あなたが目の前にいたら、それを自分の手柄にはできないわね。

key: You two saw how we were coordinating the response to all the New World messes,
en: You two saw how we were coordinating the response to all the New World messes,
ja: ニューワールドの騒動への対応を、あたしたちがどう調整してたか見てたでしょ、

key: Based out of the Nightclub, yeah?
en: Based out of the Nightclub, yeah?
ja: ナイトクラブを拠点にしてたの、覚えてる?

key: Turns out, Arclight here has a real knack for that sort of thing.
en: Turns out, Arclight here has a real knack for that sort of thing.
ja: 実はアークライトってそういうことにすごく才能があったのよ。

key: ARCLIGHT: Yeah, I guess I've done all right.
en: ARCLIGHT: Yeah, I guess I've done all right.
ja: アークライト: ああ、まあまあやれてると思うぜ。

key: Realized I could do a lot of good out there.
en: Realized I could do a lot of good out there.
ja: 外に出りゃ色々いいことができるって気付いたんだ。

key: Got into a lot of community organizing, eventually took over a lot of Adrienn's job responsibilities.
en: Got into a lot of community organizing, eventually took over a lot of Adrienn's job responsibilities.
ja: 地域活動にどっぷり関わるようになって、結局アドリエンヌの仕事の大半を引き受けることになった。

key: So xe could actually rest from time to time.
en: So xe could actually rest from time to time.
ja: おかげであいつも時々ちゃんと休めるようになったんだ。

key: You wouldn't believe how much more willing people are to talk to you about public policy or whatever.
en: You wouldn't believe how much more willing people are to talk to you about public policy or whatever.
ja: 公共政策とかについて話す時、みんなどれだけ乗り気になるか、信じられねえだろうな。

key: When you're that cool guy from the TV or radio.
en: When you're that cool guy from the TV or radio.
ja: テレビやラジオに出てるイケてる兄ちゃんだとよ。

key: TAKA: That's wonderful...
en: TAKA: That's wonderful...
ja: タカ: それはすごいね……

key: It sounds like you're making a real difference out there.
en: It sounds like you're making a real difference out there.
ja: 本当に世の中を変えてるみたいだ。

key: ...Though I think you were before, too.
en: ...Though I think you were before, too.
ja: ……もっとも、前からそうだったと思うけど。

key: I always liked listening to you on the radio and stuff.
en: I always liked listening to you on the radio and stuff.
ja: ラジオとか、いつも聞くの好きだったよ。

key: Made me feel better about being stuck somewhere I didn't wanna be.
en: Made me feel better about being stuck somewhere I didn't wanna be.
ja: 行きたくない場所に閉じ込められてても、少し気が楽になったんだ。

key: ADRIENN: Be careful, the praise might go to his head.
en: ADRIENN: Be careful, the praise might go to his head.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 気を付けて、褒めすぎると調子に乗るから。

key: ARCLIGHT: Hey, quiet. I'm used to praise from fans; if that was gonna grow my ego, it would've caused problems years ago.
en: ARCLIGHT: Hey, quiet. I'm used to praise from fans; if that was gonna grow my ego, it would've caused problems years ago.
ja: アークライト: おいおい、静かにしてろ。ファンからの称賛には慣れてるさ、それでうぬぼれるなら何年も前に問題になってるぜ。

key: Happy I could help though.
en: Happy I could help though.
ja: でも力になれてうれしいぜ。

key: Pass that on; go back to your time and try to help people out too.
en: Pass that on; go back to your time and try to help people out too.
ja: その気持ち、お前らの時代でも持ち帰って、人助けしてやってくれ。

key: Just having someone to talk to can help a lot of people.
en: Just having someone to talk to can help a lot of people.
ja: 話し相手がいるってだけで、助かる人は大勢いるからな。

key: TAKA: Thanks... Both of you, really.
en: TAKA: Thanks... Both of you, really.
ja: タカ: ありがとう……本当に、二人とも。

key: For everything.
en: For everything.
ja: 全部に対して。

key: I mean, we've heard a lot about what an amazing Champion Shelly is.
en: I mean, we've heard a lot about what an amazing Champion Shelly is.
ja: シェリーがどれだけすごいチャンピオンか、色々聞いたよ。

key: But it's obvious for things to be as good as they are, she must have a great team supporting her too.
en: But it's obvious for things to be as good as they are, she must have a great team supporting her too.
ja: でもこれだけうまくいってるってことは、支えてる仲間もすごいってことだよね。

key: ADRIENN: We do our best.
en: ADRIENN: We do our best.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 精一杯やってるつもりよ。

key: Even if there are some issues still.
en: Even if there are some issues still.
ja: まだ問題は色々あるけど。

key: Every time we work on a major project, it feels like we spend just as much time on something silly.
en: Every time we work on a major project, it feels like we spend just as much time on something silly.
ja: 大きなプロジェクトに取り組むたびに、くだらないことに同じくらいの時間を取られてる気がするわ。

key: Usually the something silly is finding another Vulpix room.
en: Usually the something silly is finding another Vulpix room.
ja: そのくだらないことって、大抵また別のロコンの部屋を見つけることなんだけど。

key: I swear she stashed them everywhere...
en: I swear she stashed them everywhere...
ja: 本当にあちこちに隠してたんだから……

key: ARCLIGHT: Hey, I'm not complaining.
en: ARCLIGHT: Hey, I'm not complaining.
ja: アークライト: おいおい、文句言ってねえよ。

key: If we're stumbling on secret rooms hidden away by former Champions?
en: If we're stumbling on secret rooms hidden away by former Champions?
ja: 歴代チャンピオンが隠してた秘密の部屋に出くわすなら、

key: I'd take rooms of Vulpix plushes over anything Lin did any day of the week.
en: I'd take rooms of Vulpix plushes over anything Lin did any day of the week.
ja: リンがやらかしたことに比べりゃ、ロコンのぬいぐるみだらけの部屋の方が全然マシだぜ。

key: ADRIENN: Can't argue with that.
en: ADRIENN: Can't argue with that.
ja: アドリエンヌ: それには反論できないわね。

key: Hey, \PN.
en: Hey, \PN.
ja: ねえ、\PN。

key: Shelly's done an amazing job as Champion.
en: Shelly's done an amazing job as Champion.
ja: シェリーはチャンピオンとしてすばらしい仕事をしてくれてるわ。

key: Go back to your time and do an even better job.
en: Go back to your time and do an even better job.
ja: あなたの時代に戻ったら、それ以上の仕事をしてね。

key: If I chose the wrong person, that'll make me look really bad!
en: If I chose the wrong person, that'll make me look really bad!
ja: 選んだ人が間違ってたら、わたしの立場がないもの!

key: TAKA: With people like you working on the administrative side...
en: TAKA: With people like you working on the administrative side...
ja: タカ: 二人みたいな人が行政側にいてくれるなら……

key: I think Reborn is in good hands whoever is Champion.
en: I think Reborn is in good hands whoever is Champion.
ja: 誰がチャンピオンになっても、リボーンは安泰だと思うよ。

key: ELIAS: Good to see you as well.
en: ELIAS: Good to see you as well.
ja: イライアス: あなたにもお会いできて何よりです。

key: It's been a while, Adrienn.
en: It's been a while, Adrienn.
ja: お久しぶりですね、アドリエンヌ。

key: ADRIENN: Been even longer for me.
en: ADRIENN: Been even longer for me.
ja: アドリエンヌ: わたしにとってはもっと久しぶりよ。

key: Glad you're all right though.
en: Glad you're all right though.
ja: でも無事で良かったわ。

key: Things got pretty crazy with everything that happened, but I know most people were just,
en: Things got pretty crazy with everything that happened, but I know most people were just,
ja: 色々起きて大変だったけど、大抵の人はただ、

key: Trying to do what they thought was best.
en: Trying to do what they thought was best.
ja: 自分なりに最善を尽くそうとしてただけだって分かってるわ。

key: ELIAS: I appreciate that, although I feel I made mistakes at every turn.
en: ELIAS: I appreciate that, although I feel I made mistakes at every turn.
ja: イライアス: そう言っていただけるのはありがたいですが、私は事あるごとに間違いを犯していたように思います。

key: Clearly that doesn't hold true for you.
en: Clearly that doesn't hold true for you.
ja: あなたには当てはまらないようですが。

key: You look quite so relaxed compared to then, things must be going well.
en: You look quite so relaxed compared to then, things must be going well.
ja: あの頃に比べてずいぶん落ち着いて見えますし、うまくいっているようですね。

key: ELIAS: I can't say I watched enough television or radio to be familiar with you.
en: ELIAS: I can't say I watched enough television or radio to be familiar with you.
ja: イライアス: あなたについては、テレビやラジオをそれほど見聞きしていたわけではないので、詳しくは存じません。

key: Beyond your work fighting Meteor and dealing with the aftermath.
en: Beyond your work fighting Meteor and dealing with the aftermath.
ja: メテオとの戦いやその後始末に尽力されたことは別として。

key: But it sounds like you've been helping people for a long time.
en: But it sounds like you've been helping people for a long time.
ja: ですが、長い間人助けを続けてこられたようですね。

key: Probably more than just the last ten years.
en: Probably more than just the last ten years.
ja: おそらくこの十年だけの話ではないのでしょう。

key: Nice of you to say, though.
en: Nice of you to say, though.
ja: でもそう言っていただけるのはうれしいわ。

key: You try to do the same thing back in your time, all right?
en: You try to do the same thing back in your time, all right?
ja: あなたの時代でも同じことをしてみてね、いい?

key: Everything with Meteor was messy, sure.
en: Everything with Meteor was messy, sure.
ja: メテオの一件は色々ひどかったけど、確かに。

key: And I think a lot of people will be way less happy with you than they are here with ten years to move on.
en: And I think a lot of people will be way less happy with you than they are here with ten years to move on.
ja: 十年経って気持ちの整理がついたここの人たちに比べたら、あなたの時代の人たちはずっと不満に思うでしょうね。

key: But if you respect people doing good, then follow their lead and do the same.
en: But if you respect people doing good, then follow their lead and do the same.
ja: でも善いことをする人を尊敬するなら、その人たちに倣って自分でも同じことをすればいいのよ。

key: ELIAS: Wise words, of course.
en: ELIAS: Wise words, of course.
ja: イライアス: もちろん、賢明な言葉です。

key: I can only do my best.
en: I can only do my best.
ja: 私にできるのは最善を尽くすことだけです。

key: As you clearly have, too.
en: As you clearly have, too.
ja: あなたが明らかにそうしてこられたように。

key: After all, we've heard a lot about what a talented Champion Shelly is.
en: After all, we've heard a lot about what a talented Champion Shelly is.
ja: そもそも、シェリーがどれほど才能あるチャンピオンか、色々耳にしていますから。

key: But it's obvious that for things to be as good as they are, she must have a highly skilled team supporting her, too.
en: But it's obvious that for things to be as good as they are, she must have a highly skilled team supporting her, too.
ja: ですがこれほどうまくいっているということは、彼女を支える有能な仲間もいるに違いありません。

key: ELIAS: You know, I suspect that with people like you working on the administrative side of things?
en: ELIAS: You know, I suspect that with people like you working on the administrative side of things?
ja: イライアス: あなたのような方が行政側で働いているのであれば、

key: Reborn will be in good hands whoever is Champion.
en: Reborn will be in good hands whoever is Champion.
ja: 誰がチャンピオンであろうと、リボーンは安泰だと思いますよ。

key: ADRIENN: Thanks.
en: ADRIENN: Thanks.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ありがとう。

key: I appreciate the faith.
en: I appreciate the faith.
ja: その信頼、うれしく思うわ。

key: And you too.
en: And you too.
ja: あなたもね。

key: I'm sure you can make a difference, just like Arc said.
en: I'm sure you can make a difference, just like Arc said.
ja: アークが言った通り、あなたならきっと世の中を変えられるはずよ。

key: I'll see you two around.
en: I'll see you two around.
ja: また会いましょう。

key: ARCLIGHT: Yeah, see you later.
en: ARCLIGHT: Yeah, see you later.
ja: アークライト: ああ、またな。

key: Enjoy the party;
en: Enjoy the party;
ja: パーティー楽しめよ、

key: Shelly went all out, especially given how last minute this was.
en: Shelly went all out, especially given how last minute this was.
ja: こんな急な話だったのに、シェリーは全力を尽くしたんだからな。

key: ARCLIGHT: Who'd have thought that letting you all run...
en: ARCLIGHT: Who'd have thought that letting you all run...
ja: アークライト: お前らに任せて……

key: I mean, basically just disaster response, out of my club,
en: I mean, basically just disaster response, out of my club,
ja: まあ、要するに災害対応をオレのクラブでやらせただけだけどな、

key: Would lead to all of this.
en: Would lead to all of this.
ja: それがこんなことにつながるなんて、誰が思っただろうな。

key: Sorry you ended up getting flung through time for all that,
en: Sorry you ended up getting flung through time for all that,
ja: そのせいで時間を飛ばされる羽目になって悪かったな、

key: Hope it wasn't too long for you, at least.
en: Hope it wasn't too long for you, at least.
ja: 少なくとも、そんなに長くなかったことを願うぜ。

key: I'm sure you'll do a great job with it when you get back, too.
en: I'm sure you'll do a great job with it when you get back, too.
ja: 戻ったら、そっちでもきっとうまくやれるさ。

key: Oh, and watch out for some of the Legendaries when you get back.
en: Oh, and watch out for some of the Legendaries when you get back.
ja: ああ、それと戻ったら伝説のポケモンには気を付けろよ。

key: I heard that dealing with a few of them got real weird.
en: I heard that dealing with a few of them got real weird.
ja: 何体か、対応がえらく妙なことになったって聞いたぜ。

key: CAIN: Well, hey there, you~
en: CAIN: Well, hey there, you~
ja: カイン: よう、お前さん~

key: Miss me so much you wanted to chat again?
en: Miss me so much you wanted to chat again?
ja: また話したくなるくらいオレが恋しかったってか?

key: I can't blame you, hard to look away from someone as cute as me.
en: I can't blame you, hard to look away from someone as cute as me.
ja: 責められねえよなあ、オレみたいに可愛いやつからは目を離せねえもんな。

key: Y'know, I really missed you.
en: Y'know, I really missed you.
ja: なあ、マジで会いたかったぜ。

key: Shelly is a great person, and a great Champion.
en: Shelly is a great person, and a great Champion.
ja: シェリーはいいやつだし、すごいチャンピオンだ。

key: Maybe even better than you would've been? I'll probably never know.
en: Maybe even better than you would've been? I'll probably never know.
ja: お前よりすごかったかもな? まあ知りようがねえけどよ。

key: ...But you were my friend, and you were there for so much.
en: ...But you were my friend, and you were there for so much.
ja: ……でもお前はオレの友達だったし、色んなことに関わってたんだ。

key: You can hardly blame me for wishing you were still about.
en: You can hardly blame me for wishing you were still about.
ja: お前がまだいてくれたらって思うのも無理ないだろ。

key: Now you're here again, I guess all there is to say is...
en: Now you're here again, I guess all there is to say is...
ja: で、お前がまたここにいるってことは、言うべきことは一つだけだよな……

key: I hope your next ten years are as happy and fun as the last ten years were for all of us.
en: I hope your next ten years are as happy and fun as the last ten years were for all of us.
ja: お前のこれからの十年が、オレたちのこの十年みたいに幸せで楽しいものになるといいぜ。

key: Give 'em hell, \PN.
en: Give 'em hell, \PN.
ja: ぶちかましてやれよ、\PN。

key: Make sure everyone knows that the day you got your starter at the Grand Hall?
en: Make sure everyone knows that the day you got your starter at the Grand Hall?
ja: グランドホールで御三家をもらったあの日、

key: A truly magnificent trainer started their journey in Reborn proper.
en: A truly magnificent trainer started their journey in Reborn proper.
ja: 本物のすごいトレーナーがリボーンで旅を始めたんだって、みんなに知らしめてやれよ。

key: ...I guess you and Victoria did too, huh?
en: ...I guess you and Victoria did too, huh?
ja: ……まあ、お前とヴィクトリアもそうだったんだよな?

key: ...Joking aside again, I'm sure you'll do great.
en: ...Joking aside again, I'm sure you'll do great.
ja: ……冗談はさておき、お前ならきっとうまくやれるぜ。

key: Good luck out there.
en: Good luck out there.
ja: 頑張れよ。

key: CAIN: Hey hey hey~
en: CAIN: Hey hey hey~
ja: カイン: よぉよぉよぉ~

key: Here I am talking to my favorite sister.
en: Here I am talking to my favorite sister.
ja: お気に入りの妹と話してたと思ったら、

key: And my favorite time travelers show up too?
en: And my favorite time travelers show up too?
ja: お気に入りの時間旅行者まで登場かよ?

key: Is today my lucky day, or what?
en: Is today my lucky day, or what?
ja: 今日はオレのラッキーデーってやつか?

key: AYA: Cain, everything's a favorite when you're that specific.
en: AYA: Cain, everything's a favorite when you're that specific.
ja: アヤ: カイン、そんな限定の付け方したら何でもお気に入りになるでしょ。

key: CAIN: That's the point.
en: CAIN: That's the point.
ja: カイン: それが狙いだぜ。

key: It's about letting everyone share in the love~
en: It's about letting everyone share in the love~
ja: みんなに愛を分け与えるってことさ~

key: AYA: Hey \PN, hey Taka.
en: AYA: Hey \PN, hey Taka.
ja: アヤ: ねえ\PN、タカも。

key: Good to see you both back safe.
en: Good to see you both back safe.
ja: 二人とも無事に戻ってきて良かった。

key: TAKA: Cain, Aya... Hey.
en: TAKA: Cain, Aya... Hey.
ja: タカ: カイン、アヤ……やあ。

key: You both look well, nice to see you too.
en: You both look well, nice to see you too.
ja: 二人とも元気そうだね、会えてうれしいよ。

key: CAIN: Well doesn't even begin to cover it!
en: CAIN: Well doesn't even begin to cover it!
ja: カイン: 「元気」なんて言葉じゃ全然足りねえぜ!

key: You're talking to one of the region's most famous musicians.
en: You're talking to one of the region's most famous musicians.
ja: お前は今、この地方で一番有名なミュージシャンの一人と話してるんだ。

key: As well as her charming, brilliant, and all around very hot brother.
en: As well as her charming, brilliant, and all around very hot brother.
ja: それに、彼女の魅力的で優秀で、とにかくイケてる兄貴ともな。

key: AYA: Modest as always, Cain.
en: AYA: Modest as always, Cain.
ja: アヤ: 相変わらず謙虚ね、カイン。

key: But yeah, mine and Hardy's band is doing pretty great.
en: But yeah, mine and Hardy's band is doing pretty great.
ja: でもまあ、あたしとハーディのバンドはかなりうまくいってるわよ。

key: Gotta be doing something right if I've got so many fans, right?
en: Gotta be doing something right if I've got so many fans, right?
ja: こんなにファンがいるんだから、何か正しいことやってるってことよね?

key: I mean, even if we didn't have all the fans, I'd say we're going pretty well.
en: I mean, even if we didn't have all the fans, I'd say we're going pretty well.
ja: まあ、ファンがいなくたって、うまくいってるって言えるけど。

key: Our music kicks ass.
en: Our music kicks ass.
ja: あたしたちの音楽は最高なんだから。

key: TAKA: If the people that make it like it so much, it must be good.
en: TAKA: If the people that make it like it so much, it must be good.
ja: タカ: 作ってる本人がそんなに好きなら、きっといい音楽なんだろうね。

key: It's made with love and care and all that stuff...
en: It's made with love and care and all that stuff...
ja: 愛情とか丁寧さとか、そういうものが込められてるってことだし……

key: CAIN: That's the attitude!
en: CAIN: That's the attitude!
ja: カイン: その調子だぜ!

key: If you give everything your all, things should work out fine.
en: If you give everything your all, things should work out fine.
ja: 何事も全力でやりゃ、うまくいくもんだ。

key: Or at least you'll have enjoyed it if they don't!
en: Or at least you'll have enjoyed it if they don't!
ja: うまくいかなくても、少なくとも楽しめてるはずだしな!

key: AYA: Truer words have never been spoken by the king of giving their all to things when you really don't need to.
en: AYA: Truer words have never been spoken by the king of giving their all to things when you really don't need to.
ja: アヤ: そんな必要ないことにまで全力を注ぐ王様に言われると、なおさら真実味があるわね。

key: In fact, you two will get a kick out of this.
en: In fact, you two will get a kick out of this.
ja: それより、これ聞いたら二人とも面白がると思うわよ。

key: A few years back, a government position opened up in Reborn City, some inspector job or other that nobody really wanted.
en: A few years back, a government position opened up in Reborn City, some inspector job or other that nobody really wanted.
ja: 数年前、リボーンシティで誰もやりたがらない検査官か何かの公職に空きが出たの。

key: Kind of job you're voted in for but the last person had been doing it for like forty years or whatever,
en: Kind of job you're voted in for but the last person had been doing it for like forty years or whatever,
ja: 選挙で選ばれる仕事なんだけど、前任者が四十年くらいずっとやってて、

key: And apparently did an awful job that whole time,
en: And apparently did an awful job that whole time,
ja: その間ずっとひどい仕事ぶりだったらしくて、

key: So nobody wanted to clean up that mess.
en: So nobody wanted to clean up that mess.
ja: だから誰もその後始末をやりたがらなかったのよ。

key: So only one candidate ran and won by default.
en: So only one candidate ran and won by default.
ja: 結局候補者は一人だけで、不戦勝で当選したの。

key: Anyway, the result is that now Madame Meganium holds a governmental position in Reborn City.
en: Anyway, the result is that now Madame Meganium holds a governmental position in Reborn City.
ja: とにかく、その結果、今リボーンシティの公職にはメガニウム夫人が就いてるってわけ。

key: Cain here saw that and remembered that an election for the Mayor of the newly cleaned up Byxbysion Ward was coming up.
en: Cain here saw that and remembered that an election for the Mayor of the newly cleaned up Byxbysion Ward was coming up.
ja: カインはそれを見て、きれいになったばかりのビクスビジョン地区の区長選挙が近いことを思い出したの。

key: And thought it would be very funny if he could enter a Garbodor in the running for that job.
en: And thought it would be very funny if he could enter a Garbodor in the running for that job.
ja: それで、ダストダスをその選挙に出したら面白いだろうなって思いついたわけ。

key: CAIN: Hey, Bigglesworth isn't just 'a Garbodor', he's a friend!
en: CAIN: Hey, Bigglesworth isn't just 'a Garbodor', he's a friend!
ja: カイン: おい、ビグルスワースはただの「ダストダス」じゃねえ、友達だぜ!

key: He can talk, he even battles properly.
en: He can talk, he even battles properly.
ja: しゃべれるし、ちゃんとバトルもできるんだからな。

key: TAKA: Don't all Pokémon, like...
en: TAKA: Don't all Pokémon, like...
ja: タカ: ポケモンって、その、みんな……

key: Just kind of already know how to battle?
en: Just kind of already know how to battle?
ja: 元からバトルの仕方くらい知ってるんじゃ?

key: CAIN: Yeah but I mean, using Pokéballs and stuff.
en: CAIN: Yeah but I mean, using Pokéballs and stuff.
ja: カイン: いや、そうじゃなくて、モンスターボールとか使ってな。

key: Like a trainer rather than a Pokémon.
en: Like a trainer rather than a Pokémon.
ja: ポケモンじゃなくてトレーナーみたいにってことだ。

key: He can talk, so it's not that much of a stretch.
en: He can talk, so it's not that much of a stretch.
ja: しゃべれるんだから、そんなに無茶な話でもねえだろ。

key: TAKA: That's... interesting.
en: TAKA: That's... interesting.
ja: タカ: それは……面白いね。

key: AYA: Anyway, even something silly like this, Cain decides to dedicate all his time and attention to.
en: AYA: Anyway, even something silly like this, Cain decides to dedicate all his time and attention to.
ja: アヤ: とにかく、こんなくだらないことにまで、カインは全ての時間と労力を注ぎ込むわけ。

key: And actually ends up running a very good and compelling political campaign on no budget.
en: And actually ends up running a very good and compelling political campaign on no budget.
ja: それで実際、予算ゼロですごく説得力のある選挙運動をやってのけたのよ。

key: So, long story short, Mayor Bigglesworth has a record high approval rating?
en: So, long story short, Mayor Bigglesworth has a record high approval rating?
ja: 手短に言うと、ビグルスワース区長は支持率が過去最高でね?

key: And last year Byxbysion overtook Lapis in opinion polls as the nicest ward to live in?
en: And last year Byxbysion overtook Lapis in opinion polls as the nicest ward to live in?
ja: 去年、住みやすい地区の世論調査でビクスビジョンがラピスを抜いたのよ?

key: CAIN: Yeah and I guess I work in politics now.
en: CAIN: Yeah and I guess I work in politics now.
ja: カイン: ああ、それでオレは今政界で働いてるってわけだ。

key: It's pretty neat.
en: It's pretty neat.
ja: なかなかイケてるだろ。

key: AYA: He's being modest, he's incredibly good at it.
en: AYA: He's being modest, he's incredibly good at it.
ja: アヤ: 謙遜してるけど、本当にすごく上手いのよ。

key: CAIN: Oh yeah?
en: CAIN: Oh yeah?
ja: カイン: そうか?

key: Well YOU are a very good musician and a lovely sister.
en: Well YOU are a very good musician and a lovely sister.
ja: じゃあお前はすごくいいミュージシャンで、可愛い妹だな。

key: So there.
en: So there.
ja: そういうことだ。

key: AYA: I know all that, I'm great.
en: AYA: I know all that, I'm great.
ja: アヤ: 分かってるわよ、あたしはすごいの。

key: AYA: Hey, ask Cain what Bigglesworth's campaign slogan was.
en: AYA: Hey, ask Cain what Bigglesworth's campaign slogan was.
ja: アヤ: ねえ、ビグルスワースの選挙スローガンが何だったか、カインに聞いてみて。

key: TAKA: Uh...
en: TAKA: Uh...
ja: タカ: えっと……

key: Hey, Cain, what was the campaign slogan?
en: Hey, Cain, what was the campaign slogan?
ja: ねえカイン、選挙スローガンって何だったの?

key: CAIN: I'm glad you asked!
en: CAIN: I'm glad you asked!
ja: カイン: 聞いてくれてうれしいぜ!

key: "With so many piles of garbage running for office,
en: "With so many piles of garbage running for office,
ja: 「これだけゴミみたいな候補者が立候補してる中、

key: Don't vote for a Garbage Can't.
en: Don't vote for a Garbage Can't.
ja: ゴミ以下には入れるな。

key: Vote for a Garbage Can.
en: Vote for a Garbage Can.
ja: ゴミ箱に入れろ。

key: Vote Bigglesworth."
en: Vote Bigglesworth."
ja: ビグルスワースに一票を。」

key: TAKA: That... is very catchy.
en: TAKA: That... is very catchy.
ja: タカ: それは……すごく覚えやすいね。

key: CAIN: I'm glad you think so, it's my job now!
en: CAIN: I'm glad you think so, it's my job now!
ja: カイン: そう思ってもらえてうれしいぜ、今やそれがオレの仕事だからな!

key: ...Although it isn't without difficulty.
en: ...Although it isn't without difficulty.
ja: ……とはいえ、大変なこともあるけどな。

key: Shelly doesn't know it started as a joke, and it's gone so far I don't have the heart to tell her.
en: Shelly doesn't know it started as a joke, and it's gone so far I don't have the heart to tell her.
ja: シェリーは最初冗談で始まったって知らないし、もうここまで来ちまうと、今さら言う気にもなれねえんだ。

key: She thinks I just had some kind of brilliant insight that Bigglesworth would be so good at the job.
en: She thinks I just had some kind of brilliant insight that Bigglesworth would be so good at the job.
ja: あいつはオレがビグルスワースの適性を見抜く天才的な洞察力を持ってたと思ってるからな。

key: So she's asked me to find good potential candidates for other positions...
en: So she's asked me to find good potential candidates for other positions...
ja: だから他のポストにも良さそうな候補を探してくれって頼まれてよ……

key: Like, I'm happy to help, but I feel like that was more a fluke than anything else...
en: Like, I'm happy to help, but I feel like that was more a fluke than anything else...
ja: 手伝うのは構わねえけど、あれはただのまぐれだったって気がしてならねえんだ……

key: TAKA: I mean, either way, it sounds like you've both found things you're really good at?
en: TAKA: I mean, either way, it sounds like you've both found things you're really good at?
ja: タカ: まあ、どっちにしても、二人とも本当に得意なものを見つけたみたいだね?

key: And enjoy?
en: And enjoy?
ja: しかも楽しんでる?

key: That's pretty cool.
en: That's pretty cool.
ja: それってすごくいいことだと思うよ。

key: AYA: Yeah, the broody edgy poison girl turned out to be a great musician.
en: AYA: Yeah, the broody edgy poison girl turned out to be a great musician.
ja: アヤ: そうね、陰気でとんがった毒タイプ好きな女の子が、結局すごいミュージシャンになったってわけ。

key: And the loud over-the-top guy that loves being the center of attention ended up having a knack for politics.
en: And the loud over-the-top guy that loves being the center of attention ended up having a knack for politics.
ja: それに、目立つのが大好きな騒がしい男が、政治の才能を発揮するなんてね。

key: Who could have POSSIBLY guessed those outcomes?
en: Who could have POSSIBLY guessed those outcomes?
ja: そんな結末、一体誰が予想できたって言うのよ?

key: CAIN: Hey now, I like to think me turning out like this is pretty surprising.
en: CAIN: Hey now, I like to think me turning out like this is pretty surprising.
ja: カイン: おいおい、オレはこうなったこと自体、結構驚きだと思ってるぜ。

key: AYA: I mean, you being good at the job isn't surprising.
en: AYA: I mean, you being good at the job isn't surprising.
ja: アヤ: あんたが仕事できるのは別に驚きじゃないわよ。

key: You actually sticking to it instead of running away when it gets stressful is, though.
en: You actually sticking to it instead of running away when it gets stressful is, though.
ja: ストレスたまっても逃げ出さずにちゃんと続けてることの方が驚きなの。

key: CAIN: Ice cold...
en: CAIN: Ice cold...
ja: カイン: 冷てえな……

key: TAKA: Oh, uh, that's...
en: TAKA: Oh, uh, that's...
ja: タカ: あ、えっと、それは……

key: CAIN: Don't worry about it, she only teases me with love.
en: CAIN: Don't worry about it, she only teases me with love.
ja: カイン: 気にすんな、こいつは愛情込めてからかってるだけだからよ。

key: AYA: Yeah, he's a pretty okay brother I guess, may as well actually be nice from time to time.
en: AYA: Yeah, he's a pretty okay brother I guess, may as well actually be nice from time to time.
ja: アヤ: まあ、こいつはそこそこいい兄貴だし、たまには優しくしてやってもいいかなって。

key: TAKA: Oh I'm glad.
en: TAKA: Oh I'm glad.
ja: タカ: そっか、良かった。

key: Anyway, it was really nice to see you both...
en: Anyway, it was really nice to see you both...
ja: とにかく、二人とも会えて本当に良かったよ……

key: I'm glad you're both doing so great.
en: I'm glad you're both doing so great.
ja: すごくうまくいってるみたいでうれしい。

key: CAIN: I'm sure in ten years you'll be in a similar boat to us, doing whatever works for you.
en: CAIN: I'm sure in ten years you'll be in a similar boat to us, doing whatever works for you.
ja: カイン: お前も十年後にはきっと似たような感じで、自分に合ったことやってるはずだぜ。

key: Remember, be like Bigglesworth.
en: Remember, be like Bigglesworth.
ja: 忘れんな、ビグルスワースを見習えってことだ。

key: Even if you wake up in the morning, look in the mirror, and don't like the person you see?
en: Even if you wake up in the morning, look in the mirror, and don't like the person you see?
ja: 朝起きて鏡を見て、そこに映る自分が気に入らなかったとしても?

key: Self love doesn't happen in a day,
en: Self love doesn't happen in a day,
ja: 自分を好きになるのは一日じゃできねえけど、

key: But if you think you're garbage,
en: But if you think you're garbage,
ja: もし自分をゴミだと思うなら、

key: Just make sure you're a garbage CAN.
en: Just make sure you're a garbage CAN.
ja: せめてゴミ「箱」になれよ。

key: Keep that up and you'll start liking the person you see, just like everyone else likes you.
en: Keep that up and you'll start liking the person you see, just like everyone else likes you.
ja: それを続けりゃ、鏡に映る自分を好きになれるさ、みんながお前を好きなようにな。

key: AYA: I write songs for a living and I still think the lines Cain comes up with are corny as hell.
en: AYA: I write songs for a living and I still think the lines Cain comes up with are corny as hell.
ja: アヤ: あたし作詞で食ってるけど、それでもカインの考える台詞はダサすぎると思うわ。

key: But he's not wrong, you're pretty cool, Taka.
en: But he's not wrong, you're pretty cool, Taka.
ja: でも間違ってはいないわね、タカ、あんたは結構イケてるわよ。

key: You too, \PN.
en: You too, \PN.
ja: \PNも ね。

key: AYA: Hey \PN, hey Elias.
en: AYA: Hey \PN, hey Elias.
ja: アヤ: ねえ\PN、イライアスも。

key: ELIAS: Hello to both of you.
en: ELIAS: Hello to both of you.
ja: イライアス: お二人ともこんにちは。

key: You appear to be doing very well.
en: You appear to be doing very well.
ja: とてもうまくいっているようですね。

key: ELIAS: I can only imagine that if the music's creator is this enthusiastic,
en: ELIAS: I can only imagine that if the music's creator is this enthusiastic,
ja: イライアス: 音楽を作った本人がこれほど情熱的なら、

key: That must shine through in the final product.
en: That must shine through in the final product.
ja: それが最終的な作品にも表れているに違いありません。

key: This Garbodor did not know how to battle?
en: This Garbodor did not know how to battle?
ja: このダストダスはバトルの仕方を知らなかった、ということですか?

key: I don't think I have ever encountered a Pokémon that does not know a single move...
en: I don't think I have ever encountered a Pokémon that does not know a single move...
ja: 一つも技を知らないポケモンに出会ったことは、私には記憶にありませんが……

key: CAIN: Oh no, I mean as in, like using Pokéballs.
en: CAIN: Oh no, I mean as in, like using Pokéballs.
ja: カイン: いやいや、そういう意味じゃなくて、モンスターボールを使うってことだよ。

key: ELIAS: I... see?
en: ELIAS: I... see?
ja: イライアス: なるほど、そういう……?

key: And you had this... talking Pokémon run for office?
en: And you had this... talking Pokémon run for office?
ja: それで、この……しゃべるポケモンを選挙に出馬させたと?

key: CAIN: Listen, Biggles is a great guy, you'd know if you met him.
en: CAIN: Listen, Biggles is a great guy, you'd know if you met him.
ja: カイン: 聞いてくれよ、ビグルスは最高のやつなんだ、会えば分かるぜ。

key: AYA: ...Anyway, even something silly like this, Cain decides to dedicate all his time and attention to.
en: AYA: ...Anyway, even something silly like this, Cain decides to dedicate all his time and attention to.
ja: アヤ: ……とにかく、こんなくだらないことにまで、カインは全ての時間と労力を注ぎ込むわけ。

key: ELIAS: I'm sorry I...
en: ELIAS: I'm sorry I...
ja: イライアス: 申し訳ありませんが、私は……

key: You're saying this Pokémon managed to actually win the mayoral race?
en: You're saying this Pokémon managed to actually win the mayoral race?
ja: このポケモンが実際に区長選挙で勝利したと、そうおっしゃるのですか?

key: That must have been a remarkable slogan, I genuinely would like to know.
en: That must have been a remarkable slogan, I genuinely would like to know.
ja: さぞ見事なスローガンだったのでしょうね、実に興味があります。

key: ELIAS: It is certainly...
en: ELIAS: It is certainly...
ja: イライアス: 確かに……

key: Snappy.
en: Snappy.
ja: 覚えやすいですね。

key: ELIAS: Many brilliant things in life start with a fluke.
en: ELIAS: Many brilliant things in life start with a fluke.
ja: イライアス: 人生における多くの素晴らしいことは、ほんの偶然から始まるものです。

key: Perhaps all good things.
en: Perhaps all good things.
ja: おそらく、良いことすべてが。

key: A fluke is little more than my Lord's will, after all, is it not?
en: A fluke is little more than my Lord's will, after all, is it not?
ja: 偶然とは我が主の意志にほかならない、そうではありませんか?

key: It sounds to me like you've both managed to find exactly the path that is best for you.
en: It sounds to me like you've both managed to find exactly the path that is best for you.
ja: お二人とも、まさに自分に一番合った道を見つけられたようですね。

key: ELIAS: ...
en: ELIAS: ...
ja: イライアス: ……

key: ELIAS: Ah, I see, this must be the 'sibling banter' I have heard much about...
en: ELIAS: Ah, I see, this must be the 'sibling banter' I have heard much about...
ja: イライアス: ああ、なるほど、これがよく聞く「兄妹漫才」というものですか……

key: Well, I am happy you both seem quite so close, family is important.
en: Well, I am happy you both seem quite so close, family is important.
ja: まあ、お二人がそれほど仲がよろしいのはうれしいことです、家族は大切ですから。

key: I do hope I can one day feel the same with what little family I still have left...
en: I do hope I can one day feel the same with what little family I still have left...
ja: 私にわずかに残された家族とも、いつか同じように感じられればと願っています……

key: But he's not wrong.
en: But he's not wrong.
ja: でも彼は間違ってないよ。

key: I'm sure if you put the right work in, you can get the right results out.
en: I'm sure if you put the right work in, you can get the right results out.
ja: 正しい努力を重ねれば、きっと正しい結果が出るはずだ。

key: I'll see you both; I'm sure you'll do great back in your time.
en: I'll see you both; I'm sure you'll do great back in your time.
ja: それでは失礼するよ、あなたの時代でもきっとうまくやれると思う。

key: AYA: Hey again, how's it going?
en: AYA: Hey again, how's it going?
ja: アヤ: またね、調子はどう?

key: Enjoying seeing how everyone is doing after so long?
en: Enjoying seeing how everyone is doing after so long?
ja: 久しぶりにみんなの様子を見られてうれしい?

key: Must be pretty surreal for you, I bet.
en: Must be pretty surreal for you, I bet.
ja: あんたにとってはかなり現実離れした感じでしょうね。

key: It'll probably be even weirder when you go back to your time and look at everyone, knowing how we'll turn out.
en: It'll probably be even weirder when you go back to your time and look at everyone, knowing how we'll turn out.
ja: あんたの時代に戻って、あたしたちがどうなるか知った上でみんなを見たら、もっと変な感じになるんだろうけど。

key: Well, how we might turn out, at least.
en: Well, how we might turn out, at least.
ja: まあ、どうなるかもしれない、って程度だけど。

key: Maybe your presence will change things?
en: Maybe your presence will change things?
ja: もしかしたらあんたがいることで変わるかもね?

key: I know you made a difference to my life when you were here, so maybe you'll continue to do so.
en: I know you made a difference to my life when you were here, so maybe you'll continue to do so.
ja: あんたがここにいた時、あたしの人生を変えてくれたのは知ってるし、これからもそうかもしれない。

key: Hey, but whenever our band starts getting big?
en: Hey, but whenever our band starts getting big?
ja: そうそう、あたしたちのバンドが売れ始めたら?

key: You better buy tickets to every show.
en: You better buy tickets to every show.
ja: 絶対全公演のチケット買いなさいよ。

key: Maybe one extra dedicated fan will help me get comfortable with it all even faster than I did.
en: Maybe one extra dedicated fan will help me get comfortable with it all even faster than I did.
ja: もう一人熱心なファンがいれば、あたしがそれに慣れるのももっと早くなるかもね。

key: And thanks for coming back, really.
en: And thanks for coming back, really.
ja: それと、戻ってきてくれて本当にありがとう。

key: Cain really missed you.
en: Cain really missed you.
ja: カインは本当にあんたのこと恋しがってたわ。

key: We all did.
en: We all did.
ja: みんなそうだったけど。

key: Even if it's only brief, it's lovely to see you.
en: Even if it's only brief, it's lovely to see you.
ja: たとえ短い間でも、会えてうれしいわ。

key: BENNETT: \PN, hello.
en: BENNETT: \PN, hello.
ja: ベネット: \PN、こんにちは。

key: Shelly always said you would be back.
en: Shelly always said you would be back.
ja: シェリーはいつも、あなたは戻ってくるって言ってましたよ。

key: And I tend to trust her word.
en: And I tend to trust her word.
ja: そして私は彼女の言葉を信じる傾向がありましてね。

key: Whether it's about the New World, Legendary Pokémon, or anything else really, she tends to know what she's talking about.
en: Whether it's about the New World, Legendary Pokémon, or anything else really, she tends to know what she's talking about.
ja: ニューワールドのことでも、伝説のポケモンのことでも、他の何のことでも、彼女は大抵の場合分かっているものです。

key: But you'd probably expect me to say that.
en: But you'd probably expect me to say that.
ja: もっとも、私がそう言うだろうと予想していたでしょうけど。

key: I've never met a Bug Type specialist I didn't get along with.
en: I've never met a Bug Type specialist I didn't get along with.
ja: 虫タイプの専門家で、私が気の合わなかった人はいません。

key: ...Well, except that cop or whatever he was from Aevium.
en: ...Well, except that cop or whatever he was from Aevium.
ja: ……まあ、アエビウムから来たあの警官か何かは別ですが。

key: I swear, you try to buy parts to repair your Genesect's cannon one singular time...
en: I swear, you try to buy parts to repair your Genesect's cannon one singular time...
ja: ゲノセクトの砲台を修理するための部品を一度買おうとしただけで……

key: And a lot of people start getting very agitated.
en: And a lot of people start getting very agitated.
ja: 大勢の人がひどく神経質になったものですよ。

key: I can't even buy fertilizer for the plants anymore; Laura has to handle that!
en: I can't even buy fertilizer for the plants anymore; Laura has to handle that!
ja: 今じゃ植物用の肥料すら買えなくて、ローラに任せるしかないんです!

key: BENNETT: ...Apologies.
en: BENNETT: ...Apologies.
ja: ベネット: ……失礼。

key: But I digress,
en: But I digress,
ja: 話がそれましたが、

key: That little incident aside, my life has been remarkably peaceful since moving into the manor with Laura.
en: That little incident aside, my life has been remarkably peaceful since moving into the manor with Laura.
ja: その小さな一件を除けば、ローラと屋敷に移ってからの私の生活は、実に平穏そのものです。

key: It's nice that we are near enough Spinel, that it's easy for both our families to visit if they want.
en: It's nice that we are near enough Spinel, that it's easy for both our families to visit if they want.
ja: スピネルにも近くて、お互いの家族が来たいと思えば訪ねやすいのもいいですね。

key: ...Although I'm quite content, visitors or no.
en: ...Although I'm quite content, visitors or no.
ja: ……もっとも、訪ねる人がいなくても私は十分満足していますが。

key: Laura's company is already so wonderful, after all.
en: Laura's company is already so wonderful, after all.
ja: そもそも、ローラと一緒にいるだけで、もう十分すばらしいですから。

key: LAURA: \PN, Elias, how delightful of you to come and greet us.
en: LAURA: \PN, Elias, how delightful of you to come and greet us.
ja: ローラ: \PN、イライアス、わざわざご挨拶に来てくださるなんて、なんてうれしいこと。

key: LAURA: \PN, Taka, how delightful of you to come and greet us.
en: LAURA: \PN, Taka, how delightful of you to come and greet us.
ja: ローラ: \PN、タカ、わざわざご挨拶に来てくださるなんて、なんてうれしいこと。

key: Amaria was just seeking some of our expertise,
en: Amaria was just seeking some of our expertise,
ja: アマリアがちょうどわたくしたちの知識を借りようとしていたところなの、

key: But we can all say hello while we help.
en: But we can all say hello while we help.
ja: でも手伝いながらでも、ちゃんとご挨拶はできますわ。

key: BENNETT: I'm glad you're both safe, welcome back.
en: BENNETT: I'm glad you're both safe, welcome back.
ja: ベネット: 二人とも無事で良かった、おかえりなさい。

key: AMARIA: Hi again, I'd love to chat more once I'm done here!
en: AMARIA: Hi again, I'd love to chat more once I'm done here!
ja: アマリア: またね、ここが終わったらもっと話したいわ!

key: TAKA: Hey again, everyone.
en: TAKA: Hey again, everyone.
ja: タカ: みんな、また会ったね。

key: Uh, you all look well.
en: Uh, you all look well.
ja: えっと、みんな元気そうだ。

key: LAURA: I certainly think so!
en: LAURA: I certainly think so!
ja: ローラ: 本当にそう思いますわ!

key: Bennett and myself take care of numerous plants and insects, and I find taking care of others is very helpful to yourself.
en: Bennett and myself take care of numerous plants and insects, and I find taking care of others is very helpful to yourself.
ja: ベネットとわたくしはたくさんの植物や虫の世話をしていて、他人の世話をすることは自分にとってもとても良いことだと思っていますの。

key: And Amaria here has recently started doing the same, getting some houseplants of her own!
en: And Amaria here has recently started doing the same, getting some houseplants of her own!
ja: それにアマリアも最近同じことを始めて、自分で観葉植物を育てるようになったのよ!

key: AMARIA: Yeah, my place was feeling a little empty, so I got a plant to liven it up!
en: AMARIA: Yeah, my place was feeling a little empty, so I got a plant to liven it up!
ja: アマリア: そうなの、部屋が少し寂しかったから、にぎやかにしようと思って植物を買ったの!

key: And one turned into two, and two turned into three, and three turned into ten...
en: And one turned into two, and two turned into three, and three turned into ten...
ja: そしたら一つが二つになって、二つが三つになって、三つが十になって……

key: I mean, you guys get it, I'm sure.
en: I mean, you guys get it, I'm sure.
ja: まあ、みんなも分かるでしょ。

key: Anyway, that's actually what I wanted to talk about.
en: Anyway, that's actually what I wanted to talk about.
ja: とにかく、それが本当に話したかったことなの。

key: One of my plants has an infestation, you see, and I don't know what to do about it...
en: One of my plants has an infestation, you see, and I don't know what to do about it...
ja: 実は、うちの植物の一つに虫がついちゃって、どうしたらいいか分からなくて……

key: LAURA: Oh, how awful!
en: LAURA: Oh, how awful!
ja: ローラ: まあ、それは大変!

key: BENNETT: ...Infestation of what?
en: BENNETT: ...Infestation of what?
ja: ベネット: ……何の虫がついたんですか?

key: AMARIA: I'm not certain, but they're tiny and when I tried to water the plant the other day, I got a little shock?
en: AMARIA: I'm not certain, but they're tiny and when I tried to water the plant the other day, I got a little shock?
ja: アマリア: よく分からないんだけど、すごく小さくて、この前水をやろうとしたら、ちょっと電気が走ったような気がして?

key: BENNETT: Sounds like Joltik.
en: BENNETT: Sounds like Joltik.
ja: ベネット: バチュルのようですね。

key: Don't worry, they're a lot less of a problem than you think.
en: Don't worry, they're a lot less of a problem than you think.
ja: 心配ありません、思っているよりずっと問題は少ないですから。

key: I mean, the plant is probably done for.
en: I mean, the plant is probably done for.
ja: まあ、その植物自体はもう駄目でしょうけど。

key: But taking care of a few hundred Joltik is remarkably easy, and they're very friendly.
en: But taking care of a few hundred Joltik is remarkably easy, and they're very friendly.
ja: でも数百匹のバチュルの世話は驚くほど簡単ですし、とても人懐こいですよ。

key: First you need--
en: First you need--
ja: まず必要なのは――

key: Oh, actually, you'll need protectors for any of your power outlets.
en: Oh, actually, you'll need protectors for any of your power outlets.
ja: ああ、実は、コンセントすべてにカバーが必要になります。

key: They're small enough to get inside and chew on wires, that can be a problem...
en: They're small enough to get inside and chew on wires, that can be a problem...
ja: 体が小さいので中に入り込んで配線をかじってしまって、それが問題になることがあって……

key: Any exposed wiring is an issue really. If your computer is higher end, you might need--
en: Any exposed wiring is an issue really. If your computer is higher end, you might need--
ja: むき出しの配線は本当に何でも問題になりますね。もしパソコンが高性能なものなら、必要になるのは――

key: LAURA: Bennett!
en: LAURA: Bennett!
ja: ローラ: ベネット!

key: She was asking about the plant, not all of the Joltik.
en: She was asking about the plant, not all of the Joltik.
ja: 彼女が聞きたいのは植物のことで、バチュル全部のことじゃないのよ。

key: I understand your excitement, but you should remember what people asked for help with when you're giving your help.
en: I understand your excitement, but you should remember what people asked for help with when you're giving your help.
ja: あなたの興奮は分かるけど、助けを求められた時は、何を頼まれたのかちゃんと覚えておかないと。

key: BENNETT: Oh, right.
en: BENNETT: Oh, right.
ja: ベネット: ああ、そうですね。

key: Sorry, Amaria. I got ahead of myself.
en: Sorry, Amaria. I got ahead of myself.
ja: すみません、アマリア。つい夢中になってしまって。

key: Laura can take this one.
en: Laura can take this one.
ja: ここからはローラに任せます。

key: AMARIA: Oh, it's okay, I understand getting excited...
en: AMARIA: Oh, it's okay, I understand getting excited...
ja: アマリア: ううん、大丈夫、夢中になる気持ちは分かるから……

key: LAURA: Right, well, Joltik are actually not a problem for the plant at all!
en: LAURA: Right, well, Joltik are actually not a problem for the plant at all!
ja: ローラ: そうね、実はバチュルは植物にとって全く問題にならないの!

key: In fact, the small electric charge they give off encourages growth!
en: In fact, the small electric charge they give off encourages growth!
ja: それどころか、あの子たちが出す小さな電流が成長を促してくれるのよ!

key: And they aren't actually interested in eating the plant, they just want the water.
en: And they aren't actually interested in eating the plant, they just want the water.
ja: それに、あの子たちは植物を食べたいわけじゃなくて、水が欲しいだけなの。

key: So you need to make sure to water the plant extra.
en: So you need to make sure to water the plant extra.
ja: だから植物には多めに水をあげるようにしないとね。

key: Oh, while they pose no danger to the plant, there is some to you.
en: Oh, while they pose no danger to the plant, there is some to you.
ja: ああ、あの子たちは植物には危険じゃないけど、あなたには危険がありますわ。

key: You'll need to water from a safe distance,
en: You'll need to water from a safe distance,
ja: 安全な距離を保って水をあげる必要があって、

key: Make sure the plant is nowhere near any electronics...
en: Make sure the plant is nowhere near any electronics...
ja: 植物を電子機器に近づけないようにして……

key: Make sure no people or Pokémon touch the plant...
en: Make sure no people or Pokémon touch the plant...
ja: 人もポケモンも植物に触れないようにして……

key: If you need to repot, wear heavy protective gear...
en: If you need to repot, wear heavy protective gear...
ja: 植え替えが必要な時は、しっかりした防護具をつけて……

key: ...There's something else, I think.
en: ...There's something else, I think.
ja: ……他にも何かあった気がするわ。

key: Bennett?
en: Bennett?
ja: ベネット?

key: BENNETT: Don't keep the plant in your kitchen, you don't want Joltik getting in your food.
en: BENNETT: Don't keep the plant in your kitchen, you don't want Joltik getting in your food.
ja: ベネット: 植物を台所に置かないでください、バチュルが食べ物に入り込んでしまいますから。

key: LAURA: Ah, how could I forget!
en: LAURA: Ah, how could I forget!
ja: ローラ: ああ、忘れるところだったわ!

key: Oh, and of course if there's anything like a hot tub or pool in your home, you don't want Joltik anywhere near that.
en: Oh, and of course if there's anything like a hot tub or pool in your home, you don't want Joltik anywhere near that.
ja: それと、もちろん家にジャグジーやプールがあるなら、バチュルを絶対に近づけちゃだめよ。
