key: BENNETT: Or if there's a lake or pond nearby outside, you probably keep the plant away from a window too.
en: BENNETT: Or if there's a lake or pond nearby outside, you probably keep the plant away from a window too.
ja: ベネット: それと外に湖や池があるなら、おそらく窓の近くにも植物を置かない方がいいでしょうね。

key: LAURA: Right, yes, and then there's...
en: LAURA: Right, yes, and then there's...
ja: ローラ: そうね、それと他にも……

key: AMARIA: ...I knew I should have asked...
en: AMARIA: ...I knew I should have asked...
ja: アマリア: ……やっぱり聞くべきじゃなかったわね……

key: I mean, literally anybody else about this.
en: I mean, literally anybody else about this.
ja: っていうか、正直、他の誰にでも聞けば良かった。

key: Hey, sorry for dragging you two into this.
en: Hey, sorry for dragging you two into this.
ja: ねえ、二人を巻き込んじゃってごめん。

key: I just wanted to know how to get those Joltik off of my plant...
en: I just wanted to know how to get those Joltik off of my plant...
ja: あたしはただ、うちの植物からバチュルを取り除く方法が知りたかっただけなの……

key: TAKA: It's fine, really.
en: TAKA: It's fine, really.
ja: タカ: 大丈夫だよ、本当に。

key: I uh, I get it.
en: I uh, I get it.
ja: その、分かる気がするから。

key: I remember asking Terra for computer help one time back in Meteor,
en: I remember asking Terra for computer help one time back in Meteor,
ja: 昔、メテオにいた頃、テラにパソコンの使い方を聞いたことがあって、

key: And I ended up getting a four hour live reading of a very bad fanfiction.
en: And I ended up getting a four hour live reading of a very bad fanfiction.
ja: 結局、すごく出来の悪いファンフィクションを四時間も朗読される羽目になったんだ。

key: Learned pretty quick to ask someone else for computer help after that.
en: Learned pretty quick to ask someone else for computer help after that.
ja: それ以来、パソコンのことは他の人に聞くようにすぐ学んだよ。

key: ...Starting to think I had a pretty weird childhood.
en: ...Starting to think I had a pretty weird childhood.
ja: ……自分の子供時代、結構変だったんじゃないかって思えてきた。

key: AMARIA: Well, I'm glad things are less weird for everyone now.
en: AMARIA: Well, I'm glad things are less weird for everyone now.
ja: アマリア: まあ、今はみんなにとって前より変じゃなくなったみたいで良かったわ。

key: I mean, in the scheme of things at least.
en: I mean, in the scheme of things at least.
ja: まあ、全体的に見ればだけど。

key: ...You two should probably sneak off, I don't think they'll be done any time soon.
en: ...You two should probably sneak off, I don't think they'll be done any time soon.
ja: ……二人はこっそり抜け出した方がいいかもね、あの二人はしばらく終わりそうにないし。

key: Good to see you again though, and welcome back.
en: Good to see you again though, and welcome back.
ja: でも会えて良かった、おかえり。

key: TAKA: Uh, yeah, you too.
en: TAKA: Uh, yeah, you too.
ja: タカ: うん、そっちもね。

key: Come on \PN, I think this is enough Joltik facts for a lifetime...
en: Come on \PN, I think this is enough Joltik facts for a lifetime...
ja: 行こう\PN、一生分のバチュル知識を仕入れた気がする……

key: ELIAS: Bennett, Laura.
en: ELIAS: Bennett, Laura.
ja: イライアス: ベネット、ローラ。

key: It is nice to see you are both well despite any... unpleasantness I may have had a hand in.
en: It is nice to see you are both well despite any...  unpleasantness I may have had a hand in.
ja: 私が関わった不快な出来事にもかかわらず、お二人とも元気そうで何よりです。

key: LAURA: It was so long ago, Elias, and I told you even then that there are no hard feelings.
en: LAURA: It was so long ago, Elias, and I told you even then that there are no hard feelings.
ja: ローラ: もうずいぶん昔のことよ、イライアス、あの時も言ったけど、わだかまりなんて全然ないわ。

key: None of us are on the Elite Four anymore anyway.
en: None of us are on the Elite Four anymore anyway.
ja: それに、もう誰も四天王じゃないんだし。

key: So in that sense, the situation has simply resolved itself, has it not?
en: So in that sense, the situation has simply resolved itself, has it not?
ja: そういう意味では、事態は自然と解決したってことじゃないかしら?

key: BENNETT: Your positivity, optimism, and speed of forgiveness still amaze me even after ten years, Laura.
en: BENNETT: Your positivity, optimism, and speed of forgiveness still amaze me even after ten years, Laura.
ja: ベネット: あなたの前向きさと楽観さ、そして許すスピードには、十年経った今でも驚かされますよ、ローラ。

key: But she is right that these things were a long time ago for us, El.
en: But she is right that these things were a long time ago for us, El.
ja: でも彼女の言う通り、我々にとってもあれはもう昔のことです、エル。

key: Any ill will has long since passed.
en: Any ill will has long since passed.
ja: わだかまりなんてとうの昔に消えていますよ。

key: ELIAS: Well, that is lovely to hear.
en: ELIAS: Well, that is lovely to hear.
ja: イライアス: それはうれしいことですね。

key: Whatever the circumstances, you both did a fine job as Elite Four.
en: Whatever the circumstances, you both did a fine job as Elite Four.
ja: 事情がどうであれ、お二人とも四天王として立派に務めを果たしていましたよ。

key: And as I said, I am glad you both look to be well.
en: And as I said, I am glad you both look to be well.
ja: それに、先ほども言った通り、お二人が元気そうでうれしく思います。

key: As do you, Amaria.
en: As do you, Amaria.
ja: アマリアさんも、ですね。

key: LAURA: I agree, we all do look well!
en: LAURA: I agree, we all do look well!
ja: ローラ: そうね、みんな元気そうよ!

key: ELIAS: There is no need to apologize.
en: ELIAS: There is no need to apologize.
ja: イライアス: 謝る必要はありませんよ。

key: Their passion is admirable.
en: Their passion is admirable.
ja: 彼らの情熱は立派なものです。

key: I must admit, I may be guilty of going on similar tangents in sermons when people ask me questions at times.
en: I must admit, I may be guilty of going on similar tangents in sermons when people ask me questions at times.
ja: 正直に言うと、私も説教の中で、人に質問された時に似たような脱線をしてしまうことがあります。

key: Given the correct topic, the majority of my colleagues back in Meteor were much the same.
en: Given the correct topic, the majority of my colleagues back in Meteor were much the same.
ja: 適切な話題であれば、かつてのメテオの同僚たちの大半も同じようなものでしたから。

key: ...Although I do concede perhaps the goals bringing us together made the people drawn to the group...
en: ...Although I do concede perhaps the goals bringing us together made the people drawn to the group...
ja: ……もっとも、私たちを結びつけた目的そのものが、集まってくる人々を……

key: Less than normal.
en: Less than normal.
ja: 普通よりも少し風変わりにしていたのかもしれませんが。

key: ELIAS: While that does sound awfully rude...
en: ELIAS: While that does sound awfully rude...
ja: イライアス: それはずいぶん失礼な言い方に聞こえますが……

key: I must admit, I have spent enough time around Bennett to already know...
en: I must admit, I have spent enough time around Bennett to already know...
ja: 正直に言うと、私もベネットと十分な時間を過ごしてきたので、すでに知っていますよ……

key: Far more facts about Bug Pokémon than I ever wished to.
en: Far more facts about Bug Pokémon than I ever wished to.
ja: 望んでいた以上に、虫ポケモンについての知識を。

key: ...If we say "Hello" again later, I'm sure they won't mind.
en: ...If we say "Hello" again later, I'm sure they won't mind.
ja: ……もし後でまた「こんにちは」を言うことになっても、きっと気にしないでしょう。

key: BENNETT: Right, obviously they'll get agitated without the expensive, mineral-rich soils.
en: BENNETT: Right, obviously they'll get agitated without the expensive, mineral-rich soils.
ja: ベネット: ええ、当然ながら高価でミネラル豊富な土がないと、あの子たちは苛立ちますからね。

key: LAURA: Oh, that goes without saying.
en: LAURA: Oh, that goes without saying.
ja: ローラ: ああ、それは言うまでもないわね。

key: But not too mineral-rich!
en: But not too mineral-rich!
ja: でもミネラルが豊富すぎるのもだめ!

key: If one of them evolves, the plant and your home and probably you are in quite a bit of trouble!
en: If one of them evolves, the plant and your home and probably you are in quite a bit of trouble!
ja: もし一匹でも進化したら、植物も家も、そしてたぶんあなた自身もかなり大変なことになるわ!

key: BENNETT: Yes, although Galvantula are quite soft...
en: BENNETT: Yes, although Galvantula are quite soft...
ja: ベネット: ええ、もっともデンチュラはとても柔らかいですけどね……

key: LAURA: They are!
en: LAURA: They are!
ja: ローラ: そうなの!

key: Should we get another?
en: Should we get another?
ja: もう一匹迎えましょうか?

key: LAURA: Hello again, \PN!
en: LAURA: Hello again, \PN!
ja: ローラ: また会ったわね、\PN!

key: Apologies, I must have gotten distracted and forgotten to say goodbye after our prior conversation.
en: Apologies, I must have gotten distracted and forgotten to say goodbye after our prior conversation.
ja: ごめんなさい、前の会話の後、気を取られてさよならを言い忘れてしまったみたい。

key: It's lovely that you're back, truly.
en: It's lovely that you're back, truly.
ja: あなたが戻ってきてくれて本当にうれしいわ。

key: These days, everything is lovely.
en: These days, everything is lovely.
ja: 最近は、何もかもが素敵なの。

key: Bennett and I quit the Elite Four and have been tending to our plants and flowers together at the manor.
en: Bennett and I quit the Elite Four and have been tending to our plants and flowers together at the manor.
ja: ベネットとわたくしは四天王を辞めて、屋敷で一緒に植物やお花の世話をしているの。

key: Charlotte visits quite regularly.
en: Charlotte visits quite regularly.
ja: シャルロットも定期的に訪ねてくれるわ。

key: Saphira stops by from time to time.
en: Saphira stops by from time to time.
ja: サファイラも時々顔を出すの。

key: Even Serra and Luna say hello when they're free!
en: Even Serra and Luna say hello when they're free!
ja: セラとルナだって、時間がある時は挨拶してくれるのよ!

key: It's a lovely life we live, because we live it in a lovely world.
en: It's a lovely life we live, because we live it in a lovely world.
ja: 素敵な世界に生きているから、素敵な人生を送れているの。

key: Much of that is thanks to Shelly, but I won't forget your contribution too.
en: Much of that is thanks to Shelly, but I won't forget your contribution too.
ja: その多くはシェリーのおかげだけど、あなたの貢献も忘れないわ。

key: In saving the region, you laid the groundwork for........
en: In saving the region, you laid the groundwork for........
ja: この地方を救ったことで、あなたは……の土台を築いてくれた。

key: Everything, I guess!
en: Everything, I guess!
ja: 何もかも、っていうことになるのかしら!

key: All of this.
en: All of this.
ja: これ全部よ。

key: So from the bottom of my heart, I thank you.
en: So from the bottom of my heart, I thank you.
ja: だから、心の底から、ありがとう。

key: For helping make a world where me and my sisters can live so happily.
en: For helping make a world where me and my sisters can live so happily.
ja: わたくしと姉妹たちがこんなに幸せに暮らせる世界を作る手助けをしてくれて。

key: AMARIA: After listening to Bennett and Laura's advice, I have decided,
en: AMARIA: After listening to Bennett and Laura's advice, I have decided,
ja: アマリア: ベネットとローラのアドバイスを聞いて、決めたの、

key: To give them the plant, and get a new one.
en: To give them the plant, and get a new one.
ja: この植物は二人にあげて、新しいのを買うことにするわ。

key: But enough about that, I have spoken about it far too much already.
en: But enough about that, I have spoken about it far too much already.
ja: でもその話はもう十分すぎるくらいしたわね。

key: Ten years is a long time and I like to think I spent it well.
en: Ten years is a long time and I like to think I spent it well.
ja: 十年って長い時間だけど、ちゃんと有意義に使えたと思ってる。

key: I could probably ramble on about what I've been doing and in what ways my life has changed.
en: I could probably ramble on about what I've been doing and in what ways my life has changed.
ja: 自分が何をしてきたか、人生がどう変わったか、いくらでも語れるとは思うけど。

key: But really, I think there's only one way it's changed that matters.
en: But really, I think there's only one way it's changed that matters.
ja: でも本当に大事な変化は、たった一つだけだと思う。

key: I'm happy now.
en: I'm happy now.
ja: 今、あたしは幸せなの。

key: NOEL: He's trying his best, although I wish he'd stop telling people I'm some kind of divine gift to artistry.
en: NOEL: He's trying his best, although I wish he'd stop telling people I'm some kind of divine gift to artistry.
ja: ノエル: 父さんは頑張ってるけど、僕が芸術の神からの贈り物だとか言うのはやめてほしいんだよね。

key: Samson approached me the other day, saying he heard about me from dad.
en: Samson approached me the other day, saying he heard about me from dad.
ja: この前サムソンが来て、父さんから僕のこと聞いたって言ってさ。

key: Wanted to commission me to make some kind of bright, colorful, extravagant engagement ring.
en: Wanted to commission me to make some kind of bright, colorful, extravagant engagement ring.
ja: 派手で色鮮やかで、豪華な婚約指輪を作ってほしいって依頼してきたんだ。

key: It's not like I can't make it, but I prefer to work in my own style.
en: It's not like I can't make it, but I prefer to work in my own style.
ja: 作れないわけじゃないけど、僕は自分のスタイルで仕事したいんだよ。

key: I know he's just trying to be supportive, but I don't want people to get the wrong idea about my work.
en: I know he's just trying to be supportive, but I don't want people to get the wrong idea about my work.
ja: 応援のつもりなのは分かってるけど、僕の作品について誤解されたくないんだ。

key: RADOMUS: My my, do I hear footsteps approach?
en: RADOMUS: My my, do I hear footsteps approach?
ja: ラドマス: おやおや、足音が近づいてくるようだ。

key: Our guests of honor, perhaps?
en: Our guests of honor, perhaps?
ja: 我が名誉ある賓客たちかな?

key: NOEL: ...Here we go again, I suppose.
en: NOEL: ...Here we go again, I suppose.
ja: ノエル: ……またこれか。

key: RADOMUS: \PN! Taka!
en: RADOMUS: \PN! Taka!
ja: ラドマス: \PN! タカ!

key: It is wonderful to see you both returned.
en: It is wonderful to see you both returned.
ja: 二人とも戻ってきてくれて、実に素晴らしい。

key: And of course, what better way to welcome the guests of honor than with a gift!
en: And of course, what better way to welcome the guests of honor than with a gift!
ja: そしてもちろん、名誉ある賓客を迎えるのに贈り物以上のものはないだろう!

key: The gift of a personal meeting with the greatest artist in all of Reborn--
en: The gift of a personal meeting with the greatest artist in all of Reborn--
ja: リボーン一の芸術家との、直々の対面という贈り物を――

key: Nay, all of the world!
en: Nay, all of the world!
ja: いや、世界一と言うべきかな!

key: NOEL: ...Dad, I told you to stop saying that.
en: NOEL: ...Dad, I told you to stop saying that.
ja: ノエル: ……父さん、それ言うのやめてって言ったよね。

key: TAKA: You're an artist now?
en: TAKA: You're an artist now?
ja: タカ: 芸術家になったの?

key: ...I thought chess was your whole thing?
en: ...I thought chess was your whole thing?
ja: ……チェスが本業だったんじゃ?

key: RADOMUS: No, no, no!
en: RADOMUS: No, no, no!
ja: ラドマス: いやいやいや!

key: Wrong on all counts, I'm afraid.
en: Wrong on all counts, I'm afraid.
ja: どれも見当違いだよ、残念ながら。

key: Firstly, I haven't played chess in years-- I switched to a far more fitting pursuit for my new lifestyle.
en: Firstly, I haven't played chess in years-- I switched to a far more fitting pursuit for my new lifestyle.
ja: まず、私はもう何年もチェスを指していない――新しい生活にふさわしい、もっと相応しい趣味に切り替えたのだ。

key: Secondly, I am not the artist; it's my darling son here!
en: Secondly, I am not the artist; it's my darling son here!
ja: 次に、芸術家は私ではなく、我が愛する息子の方だ!

key: NOEL: ...
en: NOEL: ...
ja: ノエル: ……

key: NOEL: Sure, fine.
en: NOEL: Sure, fine.
ja: ノエル: うん、まあいいよ。

key: Hey, good to see you again. It's good that you're safe.
en: Hey, good to see you again. It's good that you're safe.
ja: やあ、また会えて良かった。無事で何より。

key: ...Shelly always said you were gonna be fine and you'd show up again, though, so I wasn't worried.
en: ...Shelly always said you were gonna be fine and you'd show up again, though, so I wasn't worried.
ja: ……もっとも、シェリーはいつも君なら大丈夫、また現れるって言ってたから、心配はしてなかったけどね。

key: TAKA: Hey... I like your new look, it's pretty funky.
en: TAKA: Hey... I like your new look, it's pretty funky.
ja: タカ: やあ……新しい見た目、いいね、すごくファンキーだ。

key: Suits an artist.
en: Suits an artist.
ja: 芸術家らしいよ。

key: So uh, how'd that even happen?
en: So uh, how'd that even happen?
ja: それで、その、どうしてこうなったの?

key: NOEL: It's no big deal, Shelly and I met a Xerneas one time and it...
en: NOEL: It's no big deal, Shelly and I met a Xerneas one time and it...
ja: ノエル: 大したことじゃないよ、シェリーと僕、一度ゼルネアスに会って、それで……

key: Well, I had a new appreciation for color, so I started to paint.
en: Well, I had a new appreciation for color, so I started to paint.
ja: 色への見方が新しくなったから、絵を描き始めたんだ。

key: And I didn't limit myself to just oils on a canvas.
en: And I didn't limit myself to just oils on a canvas.
ja: それに、キャンバスに油絵の具って形式にもこだわらなかった。

key: And some people seemed to like my work, so I kept doing it.
en: And some people seemed to like my work, so I kept doing it.
ja: それで何人か気に入ってくれる人がいたから、続けることにしたんだ。

key: RADOMUS: 'Some people seemed to like' it?
en: RADOMUS: 'Some people seemed to like' it?
ja: ラドマス: 「何人か気に入ってくれた」だと?

key: That doesn't even begin to cover your success!
en: That doesn't even begin to cover your success!
ja: それではお前の成功を全く言い表せていないぞ!

key: RADOMUS: From the finest galleries in Kalos...
en: RADOMUS: From the finest galleries in Kalos...
ja: ラドマス: カロス地方きっての名だたる画廊から……

key: ...To the most exclusive resorts in Sinnoh...
en: ...To the most exclusive resorts in Sinnoh...
ja: ……シンオウ地方の最も由緒あるリゾートまで……

key: Noel's art is on display in some of the most prestigious places around the world!
en: Noel's art is on display in some of the most prestigious places around the world!
ja: ノエルの作品は、世界中の最も名誉ある場所に展示されているのだ!

key: Why, just last year, he set the record for the most money a living artist has ever sold a single piece for!
en: Why, just last year, he set the record for the most money a living artist has ever sold a single piece for!
ja: それどころか、去年、存命の芸術家が一作品に対して受け取った金額の最高記録を打ち立てたのだぞ!

key: NOEL: ...I still don't think that should count when you just showed up to an art show,
en: NOEL: ...I still don't think that should count when you just showed up to an art show,
ja: ノエル: ……あれをカウントすべきじゃないと思うんだけどな、だって父さんが突然美術展に現れて、

key: Which I didn't even tell you was happening,
en: Which I didn't even tell you was happening,
ja: それも僕が開催すら教えてなかったのに、

key: And outbid the next guy by a factor of ten.
en: And outbid the next guy by a factor of ten.
ja: 次点の相手に十倍の値段で競り勝ったんだから。

key: RADOMUS: Can you blame me?
en: RADOMUS: Can you blame me?
ja: ラドマス: 私を責められるかね?

key: What better thing to spend my fortune on than an original piece by such a brilliant young artist,
en: What better thing to spend my fortune on than an original piece by such a brilliant young artist,
ja: これほど才能ある若き芸術家の原画を手に入れる以上に、財産の使い道として何がふさわしいというんだ、

key: That I can display proudly in my home!
en: That I can display proudly in my home!
ja: 我が家に誇らしげに飾れるのだからな!

key: NOEL: ...Didn't you steal that whole fortune from his dad?
en: NOEL: ...Didn't you steal that whole fortune from his dad?
ja: ノエル: ……その財産って、父さんのお父さんから丸ごと盗んだものじゃなかった?

key: RADOMUS: ...
en: RADOMUS: ...
ja: ラドマス: ……

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: RADOMUS: Anyway!
en: RADOMUS: Anyway!
ja: ラドマス: とにかく!

key: Time travel, how fascinating!
en: Time travel, how fascinating!
ja: 時間旅行とは、実に興味深い!

key: You must tell me everything!
en: You must tell me everything!
ja: すべて聞かせてもらわねばなるまい!

key: NOEL: Sorry about him.
en: NOEL: Sorry about him.
ja: ノエル: 父さんのことごめんね。

key: After things settled down he decided it was his mission in life to be the 'best father ever', whatever that means.
en: After things settled down he decided it was his mission in life to be the 'best father ever', whatever that means.
ja: 色々落ち着いてから、父さんは「史上最高の父親」になることを人生の使命にすると決めたんだ、それが何を意味するかは分からないけど。

key: ...He's a little much.
en: ...He's a little much.
ja: ……ちょっと過剰なんだよね。

key: TAKA: Must be nice to...
en: TAKA: Must be nice to...
ja: タカ: それって、なんかいいなあ……

key: Uh, never mind.
en: Uh, never mind.
ja: いや、何でもない。

key: The time travel was all right, we met some interesting people...
en: The time travel was all right, we met some interesting people...
ja: 時間旅行は悪くなかったよ、色々面白い人にも会えたし……

key: You said you don't play chess anymore?
en: You said you don't play chess anymore?
ja: もうチェスは指さないって言ってたよね?

key: RADOMUS: Yes, yes. I am a lover of strategy and mindgames, I always thought chess was the perfect game for me.
en: RADOMUS: Yes, yes. I am a lover of strategy and mindgames, I always thought chess was the perfect game for me.
ja: ラドマス: ああ、その通り。私は戦略と頭脳戦を愛する者、チェスこそ自分に完璧な競技だとずっと思っていた。

key: But it can be so solitary, can it not?
en: But it can be so solitary, can it not?
ja: だが、あまりに孤独な競技ではないかね?

key: Hardly an appropriate way for a family man to spend his time.
en: Hardly an appropriate way for a family man to spend his time.
ja: 一家の主が時間を費やすには、あまりふさわしいとは言えまい。

key: Friends, you are looking at the world champion...
en: Friends, you are looking at the world champion...
ja: 諸君、今君たちの目の前にいるのは世界チャンピオン……

key: RADOMUS: Of Monopoly!
en: RADOMUS: Of Monopoly!
ja: ラドマス: モノポリーのな!

key: NOEL: You keep saying so, but that title still doesn't exist.
en: NOEL: You keep saying so, but that title still doesn't exist.
ja: ノエル: ずっとそう言ってるけど、そんな称号は実在しないよ。

key: RADOMUS: Ah, my brilliant son, always so sharp.
en: RADOMUS: Ah, my brilliant son, always so sharp.
ja: ラドマス: ああ、我が賢明な息子よ、相変わらず鋭いな。

key: It is a title that exists in my heart!
en: It is a title that exists in my heart!
ja: その称号は私の心の中には確かに存在する!

key: And once I get enough participants to set up a world championship, it shall exist to the world!
en: And once I get enough participants to set up a world championship, it shall exist to the world!
ja: そして十分な参加者を集めて世界選手権を開けば、いずれ世界にもその存在を示すことになるだろう!

key: NOEL: ...Let me know if you ever need anything, \PN.
en: NOEL: ...Let me know if you ever need anything, \PN.
ja: ノエル: ……何か困ったことがあれば言ってね、\PN。

key: I owe you a lot.
en: I owe you a lot.
ja: 君にはずいぶん恩がある。

key: You too, Taka.
en: You too, Taka.
ja: タカもね。

key: ...Even though that feels more like my father's debts than mine.
en: ...Even though that feels more like my father's debts than mine.
ja: ……もっとも、それって僕の恩というより父さんの借りって感じもするけど。

key: TAKA: I'll keep that in mind.
en: TAKA: I'll keep that in mind.
ja: タカ: 覚えておくよ。

key: And uh, enjoy your...
en: And uh, enjoy your...
ja: それと、その……楽しんでね、

key: Family time?
en: Family time?
ja: 家族の時間を?

key: NOEL: ...Yeah.
en: NOEL: ...Yeah.
ja: ノエル: ……うん。

key: All things considered, I always do.
en: All things considered, I always do.
ja: 何にせよ、いつだって楽しんでるよ。

key: Our guest of honor, perhaps?
en: Our guest of honor, perhaps?
ja: 我が名誉ある賓客かな?

key: And not just footsteps, but the slithering of a snake too.
en: And not just footsteps, but the slithering of a snake too.
ja: それに足音だけでなく、蛇がはうような音まで聞こえるな。

key: Perhaps our guest has company of their own.
en: Perhaps our guest has company of their own.
ja: どうやら我が賓客には連れがいるようだ。

key: RADOMUS: \PN!
en: RADOMUS: \PN!
ja: ラドマス: \PN!

key: It is wonderful to see you returned.
en: It is wonderful to see you returned.
ja: 戻ってきてくれて、実に素晴らしい。

key: I see that you are also here, Elias.
en: I see that you are also here, Elias.
ja: そしてお前もそこにいるのだな、イライアス。

key: ELIAS: Radomus.
en: ELIAS: Radomus.
ja: イライアス: ラドマス。

key: You've aged horribly.
en: You've aged horribly.
ja: ひどく老けたものだな。

key: RADOMUS: Why, I was about to say the same thing, my dear ex-employee.
en: RADOMUS: Why, I was about to say the same thing, my dear ex-employee.
ja: ラドマス: おや、それはこちらの台詞だよ、我が愛しの元従業員くん。

key: It looks like it's been ten years for you, too.
en: It looks like it's been ten years for you, too.
ja: お前にとっても十年が経ったようだな。

key: Today is your lucky day, however!
en: Today is your lucky day, however!
ja: だが今日はお前にとって幸運な日だ!

key: For someone so old that they look mere moments from death, it must be rare to be afforded such a wonderful opportunity.
en: For someone so old that they look mere moments from death, it must be rare to be afforded such a wonderful opportunity.
ja: 今にも死にそうなほど老いぼれた者にとって、これほど素晴らしい機会に恵まれるとは、実にまれなことだろう。

key: The opportunity of a personal meeting with the greatest artist in all of Reborn--
en: The opportunity of a personal meeting with the greatest artist in all of Reborn--
ja: リボーン一の芸術家との、直々の対面という機会に――

key: ELIAS: World Champion of Chess, and now, what, World Champion of Art?
en: ELIAS: World Champion of Chess, and now, what, World Champion of Art?
ja: イライアス: チェスの世界チャンピオンから、今度は何だ、芸術の世界チャンピオンか?

key: Art suits you, given how creative you are at coming up with lies to explain your stolen wealth.
en: Art suits you, given how creative you are at coming up with lies to explain your stolen wealth.
ja: 芸術はお前によく似合う、盗んだ財産の言い訳をでっち上げるその創造力を思えばな。

key: RADOMUS: Wrong about everything as usual, Elias.
en: RADOMUS: Wrong about everything as usual, Elias.
ja: ラドマス: 相変わらず何もかも見当違いだな、イライアス。

key: While you are correct that I have moved on from the life of a chessmaster.
en: While you are correct that I have moved on from the life of a chessmaster.
ja: チェスマスターとしての生き方から離れたというのは正しいが。

key: I am not the artist-- that would be my darling son here!
en: I am not the artist-- that would be my darling son here!
ja: 芸術家は私ではない――我が愛する息子の方だ!

key: Hey, good to see you again \PN. It's good that you're safe.
en: Hey, good to see you again \PN. It's good that you're safe.
ja: やあ、また会えて良かった\PN。無事で何より。

key: ELIAS: You have my sincerest congratulations for turning into such a polite young man,
en: ELIAS: You have my sincerest congratulations for turning into such a polite young man,
ja: イライアス: これほど礼儀正しい青年に育ったこと、心から祝福しよう、

key: Despite how gravely this man's very existence stacked the odds against you.
en: Despite how gravely this man's very existence stacked the odds against you.
ja: この男の存在そのものが、これほど不利な条件になっていたにもかかわらずな。

key: You're an artist now?
en: You're an artist now?
ja: 芸術家になったのか?

key: And some people seemed to like my work so I kept doing it.
en: And some people seemed to like my work so I kept doing it.
ja: それで何人か気に入ってくれる人がいたから、続けることにしたんだ。

key: ELIAS: That sounds an awful lot like money laundering.
en: ELIAS: That sounds an awful lot like money laundering.
ja: イライアス: それはひどくマネーロンダリングじみて聞こえるな。

key: In fact, given that your fortune was entirely stolen from myself and my master, it probably is.
en: In fact, given that your fortune was entirely stolen from myself and my master, it probably is.
ja: 実際、お前の財産が丸ごと私と我が主から盗んだものだということを考えれば、おそらくそうなのだろう。

key: How very like you, thrusting the consequences of your crimes on your child.
en: How very like you, thrusting the consequences of your crimes on your child.
ja: いかにもお前らしい、自分の犯した罪の代償を子供に押し付けるとはな。

key: RADOMUS: Oh my! What a great day this is, to receive parenting advice from such an esteemed expert!
en: RADOMUS: Oh my! What a great day this is, to receive parenting advice from such an esteemed expert!
ja: ラドマス: おやおや! こんな高名な専門家から子育てのアドバイスをいただけるとは、実にめでたい日だ!

key: Although there is something to be said for a simple difference in styles.
en: Although there is something to be said for a simple difference in styles.
ja: もっとも、単なるスタイルの違いというものもあるだろうがね。

key: After all, my daughter Luna seems to think I'm a wonderful father.
en: After all, my daughter Luna seems to think I'm a wonderful father.
ja: 何しろ、私の娘ルナは、私を素晴らしい父親だと思ってくれているようだからな。

key: NOEL: ...Let's just leave them to it.
en: NOEL: ...Let's just leave them to it.
ja: ノエル: ……もう二人には任せておこう。

key: NOEL: Sorry, \PN. Dad is... a lot.
en: NOEL: Sorry, \PN. Dad is... a lot.
ja: ノエル: ごめんね、\PN。父さんは……ちょっと濃いんだ。

key: He got really fixated on being the best father possible after things settled down and...
en: He got really fixated on being the best father possible after things settled down and...
ja: 色々落ち着いた後、史上最高の父親になることに本気でこだわり始めて……

key: Well, now I guess he has all that energy to channel into... whatever is going on over there.
en: Well, now I guess he has all that energy to channel into... whatever is going on over there.
ja: まあ、今はそのエネルギーを全部……あっちの方に注いでるってわけ。

key: RADOMUS: You know, I always felt it would be unfair to just fight you, given how old and frail you are.
en: RADOMUS: You know, I always felt it would be unfair to just fight you, given how old and frail you are.
ja: ラドマス: なあ、お前がそれほど老いて弱っているのに、ただ戦うのは不公平だとずっと思っていたのだが。

key: But given the ten years, we're about the same age now, so bring it.
en: But given the ten years, we're about the same age now, so bring it.
ja: 十年経った今なら、お互い同じ年頃だ、さあかかってこい。

key: ELIAS: Please, you couldn't fight your way out of a wet paper bag.
en: ELIAS: Please, you couldn't fight your way out of a wet paper bag.
ja: イライアス: よせ、お前はぬれた紙袋一つ突き破れないだろう。

key: Your style is no doubt more like kicking me when my back is turned.
en: Your style is no doubt more like kicking me when my back is turned.
ja: お前のやり口は、間違いなく私が背を向けた隙を蹴飛ばすようなものだろうしな。

key: NOEL: He even stopped playing chess, you know.
en: NOEL: He even stopped playing chess, you know.
ja: ノエル: 父さん、チェスもやめちゃったんだよ。

key: Decided now he was a family man, he needed a family hobby.
en: Decided now he was a family man, he needed a family hobby.
ja: 一家の主になったんだから、家族の趣味が必要だって決めてね。

key: The title doesn't exist, but he calls himself the World Champion of Monopoly now...
en: The title doesn't exist, but he calls himself the World Champion of Monopoly now...
ja: その称号は実在しないのに、自分をモノポリーの世界チャンピオンって呼んでるんだ……

key: ELIAS: Oh, and what a FINE parent you are!
en: ELIAS: Oh, and what a FINE parent you are!
ja: イライアス: おお、それはなんと「立派な」親であることか!

key: So incompatible with your own child you had to change everything about yourself just to bond?
en: So incompatible with your own child you had to change everything about yourself just to bond?
ja: 自分の子供とそれほど馬が合わず、きずなを結ぶために自分の何もかもを変えねばならなかったとはな?

key: RADOMUS: My deepest apologies I'm not pompous enough to know how to say this in the old language, but,
en: RADOMUS: My deepest apologies I'm not pompous enough to know how to say this in the old language, but,
ja: ラドマス: 古語でこれをどう言えばいいのか分からないほど尊大ではなくて申し訳ないが、

key: Those in glass houses shouldn't throw stones, Elias.
en: Those in glass houses shouldn't throw stones, Elias.
ja: ガラスの家に住む者は石を投げるべきではないぞ、イライアス。

key: NOEL: I'm glad he tries to understand me, at least.
en: NOEL: I'm glad he tries to understand me, at least.
ja: ノエル: 少なくとも、父さんは僕を理解しようとしてくれてるんだ。

key: Even if his brand of supportive can be a little... intense.
en: Even if his brand of supportive can be a little...  intense.
ja: そのやり方がちょっと……濃いのは確かだけど。

key: It's nice to have him around, even if he's embarrassing.
en: It's nice to have him around, even if he's embarrassing.
ja: そばにいてくれるのはうれしいよ、恥ずかしいけどね。

key: ...It's nice you're back too. Even being confident you would return, it's good that it finally happened.
en: ...It's nice you're back too. Even being confident you would return, it's good that it finally happened.
ja: ……君が戻ってきてくれたのもうれしいよ。戻ってくるって確信してたけど、それでも実際にそうなると良かった。

key: RADOMUS: LOOK AT ME, I'M ELIAS.
en: RADOMUS: LOOK AT ME, I'M ELIAS.
ja: ラドマス: 見ろ、私はイライアスだ。

key: I'M SO REPUGNANT THAT THE IDEA SOMEBODY COULD BE SELFLESS ENOUGH TO TREAT ME WELL IS TOTALLY ALIEN!
en: I'M SO REPUGNANT THAT THE IDEA SOMEBODY COULD BE SELFLESS ENOUGH TO TREAT ME WELL IS TOTALLY ALIEN!
ja: 私はあまりに嫌われ者すぎて、誰かが無私の心で私に良くしてくれるなんて考えは、全く理解できないのだ!

key: SO MUCH SO THAT I CONVINCED MYSELF A RANDOM YOUTH IS ARCEUS BECAUSE THAT'S THE ONLY EXPLANATION!
en: SO MUCH SO THAT I CONVINCED MYSELF A RANDOM YOUTH IS ARCEUS BECAUSE THAT'S THE ONLY EXPLANATION!
ja: だからこそ、見知らぬ若者をアルセウスだと信じ込むほかなかったのだ、それ以外に説明がつかないからな!

key: ELIAS: Well I never...
en: ELIAS: Well I never...
ja: イライアス: なんという言い草だ……

key: WELL, MY NAME IS RADOMUS!
en: WELL, MY NAME IS RADOMUS!
ja: さて、私の名前はラドマスだ!

key: I SPENT SO LONG SPOUTING PSEUDO- PHILOSOPHICAL NONSENSE EVERYONE THOUGHT I WAS SOME KIND OF INTELLECTUAL.
en: I SPENT SO LONG SPOUTING PSEUDO- PHILOSOPHICAL NONSENSE EVERYONE THOUGHT I WAS SOME KIND OF INTELLECTUAL.
ja: あまりに長い間、意味不明な似非哲学をまくし立てていたせいで、みんな私を知識人か何かだと思い込んでいた。

key: SO I JUST LIED AND TOLD THEM I WAS A CHESSMASTER.
en: SO I JUST LIED AND TOLD THEM I WAS A CHESSMASTER.
ja: だから私はただうそをついて、自分はチェスマスターだと言ったのだ。

key: I'M NOT EVEN VERY GOOD AT CHESS, BUT NOBODY CAN STAND MY COMPANY LONG ENOUGH TO PLAY A GAME TO FIND OUT!
en: I'M NOT EVEN VERY GOOD AT CHESS, BUT NOBODY CAN STAND MY COMPANY LONG ENOUGH TO PLAY A GAME TO FIND OUT!
ja: チェスもさほど得意ではないのだが、誰も私と一局指すほど長く一緒にいられないから、誰にもバレやしない!

key: NOEL: ...Hey, let's get some tea or something.
en: NOEL: ...Hey, let's get some tea or something.
ja: ノエル: ……ねえ、お茶でも飲みに行こうか。

key: They're not exactly young men; all that yelling will tire them out eventually...
en: They're not exactly young men; all that yelling will tire them out eventually...
ja: もう若くはないんだし、あれだけ叫んでればそのうち疲れるはずだよ……

key: ...Probably.
en: ...Probably.
ja: ……たぶんね。

key: \PN and Noel proceeded to have a lovely cup of tea at the café.
en: \PN and Noel proceeded to have a lovely cup of tea at the café.
ja: \PNとノエルはカフェで楽しくお茶を飲むことにした。

key: They discussed his art, time travel, and much more.
en: They discussed his art, time travel, and much more.
ja: 二人はノエルの芸術のことや時間旅行のこと、その他たくさんのことを話した。

key: When they returned, Radomus and Elias were indeed out of breath from all the shouting and yelling.
en: When they returned, Radomus and Elias were indeed out of breath from all the shouting and yelling.
ja: 戻ってきた時、ラドマスとイライアスは、あれだけ叫び合ったせいですっかり息切れしていた。

key: ELIAS: Well... I have... many people I'd rather greet.
en: ELIAS: Well... I have... many people I'd rather greet.
ja: イライアス: まあ……他に挨拶したい人が大勢いるのでね。

key: I will talk to you later, my Lord.
en: I will talk to you later, my Lord.
ja: また後で話そう、我が主よ。

key: RADOMUS: Good riddance...
en: RADOMUS: Good riddance...
ja: ラドマス: せいせいするな……

key: Ahem, but where are my manners.
en: Ahem, but where are my manners.
ja: んん、これは失礼した。

key: Even with the downside of the company you have brought, your return is nonetheless a good thing, \PN.
en: Even with the downside of the company you have brought, your return is nonetheless a good thing, \PN.
ja: 連れてきた相手には難があったが、それでもお前が戻ってきたことは喜ばしいことだ、\PN。

key: Welcome back, once more.
en: Welcome back, once more.
ja: 改めて、おかえり。

key: NOEL: Yeah, welcome back.
en: NOEL: Yeah, welcome back.
ja: ノエル: うん、おかえり。

key: Thanks for everything, too.
en: Thanks for everything, too.
ja: 色々本当にありがとう。

key: I'll see you around.
en: I'll see you around.
ja: また　どこかで　な。

key: RADOMUS: To think, all the time I lost being separated from my son.
en: RADOMUS: To think, all the time I lost being separated from my son.
ja: ラドマス: 息子と離れて過ごしたあの歳月を思うとな。

key: I want nothing more than to take back all those lost years, but I will make do with making up for it instead.
en: I want nothing more than to take back all those lost years, but I will make do with making up for it instead.
ja: 失った年月を丸ごと取り戻したいくらいだが、その代わりに、埋め合わせをするしかあるまい。

key: I struggled to truly understand him for quite some time but...
en: I struggled to truly understand him for quite some time but...
ja: しばらくの間、あの子を本当に理解するのに苦労したものだが……

key: He seems to crack a smile at my antics more often these days.
en: He seems to crack a smile at my antics more often these days.
ja: 最近は、私の悪ふざけにも笑みをこぼしてくれることが増えた。

key: So I can only hope I'm doing something right.
en: So I can only hope I'm doing something right.
ja: だから、何か正しいことができているのだと信じたいものだ。

key: TAKA: Oh, \PN, hey.
en: TAKA: Oh, \PN, hey.
ja: タカ: あ、\PN、やあ。

key: I was just saying hi to Luna here.
en: I was just saying hi to Luna here.
ja: ちょうどルナに挨拶してたところなんだ。

key: LUNA: Taka was telling me all about your journey through time, how fascinating.
en: LUNA: Taka was telling me all about your journey through time, how fascinating.
ja: ルナ: タカがあなたの時間旅行のこと、色々話してくれたの、とても興味深いわ。

key: But where are my manners, time travel must be exhausting!
en: But where are my manners, time travel must be exhausting!
ja: でも失礼だったわね、時間旅行なんてきっと疲れるでしょうに!

key: Would you like a refreshment?
en: Would you like a refreshment?
ja: 何か飲み物でもいかが?

key: Some tea, perhaps?
en: Some tea, perhaps?
ja: お茶でもいかが?

key: TAKA: Oh uh, me too then, if that's all right?
en: TAKA: Oh uh, me too then, if that's all right?
ja: タカ: あ、じゃあ僕も、いいかな?

key: LUNA: Certainly.
en: LUNA: Certainly.
ja: ルナ: もちろんよ。

key: Father, can you fetch our guests something to drink from the café?
en: Father, can you fetch our guests something to drink from the café?
ja: 父さん、お客様に飲み物をカフェから持ってきてくださる?

key: TAKA: If it's no trouble, I'm actually a little parched...
en: TAKA: If it's no trouble, I'm actually a little parched...
ja: タカ: 迷惑じゃなければ、実は少し喉が渇いてて……

key: LUNA: No trouble at all, there's plenty of tea to go around.
en: LUNA: No trouble at all, there's plenty of tea to go around.
ja: ルナ: 全然迷惑じゃないわ、お茶ならたっぷりあるもの。

key: Father, if you wouldn't mind running to the café?
en: Father, if you wouldn't mind running to the café?
ja: 父さん、カフェまで走ってきてもらえる?

key: ELIAS: Of course, I'll be right back.
en: ELIAS: Of course, I'll be right back.
ja: イライアス: もちろんだ、すぐ戻る。

key: TAKA: ...Okay, I need to ask.
en: TAKA: ...Okay, I need to ask.
ja: タカ: ……ねえ、聞かなきゃ気が済まないんだけど。

key: Those cat ears you're wearing look pretty good on you.
en: Those cat ears you're wearing look pretty good on you.
ja: その猫耳、すごく似合ってるね。

key: But why is he--
en: But why is he--
ja: でもなんでイライアスさんが――

key: LUNA: Oh, I told him that if was serious about repairing our relationship,
en: LUNA: Oh, I told him that if was serious about repairing our relationship,
ja: ルナ: ああ、本気で関係を修復するつもりなら、

key: He needed to put in the work to act like a real father.
en: He needed to put in the work to act like a real father.
ja: ちゃんとした父親らしく振る舞う努力をしてもらわなきゃって伝えたの。

key: ...I might have told him parents and children coordinate their outfits.
en: ...I might have told him parents and children coordinate their outfits.
ja: ……親子はおそろいの格好をするものだって言ったかもしれないわね。

key: TAKA: ...You're more mischevious than I remember.
en: TAKA: ...You're more mischevious than I remember.
ja: タカ: ……昔よりずっと悪戯っぽくなったね。

key: LUNA: Ten years may as well be an eternity, even for a man his age.
en: LUNA: Ten years may as well be an eternity, even for a man his age.
ja: ルナ: 十年って、あの人の歳になれば永遠みたいなものよ。

key: Losing everyone he felt he was meant to serve filled him with many doubts.
en: Losing everyone he felt he was meant to serve filled him with many doubts.
ja: 仕えるべきだと思っていた人たち全員を失って、あの人は色んな迷いを抱えたの。

key: I had no interest in his attempts to reach out to me, at first.
en: I had no interest in his attempts to reach out to me, at first.
ja: 最初は、あの人の歩み寄りに興味なんてなかった。

key: ...Shelly is sweet to a fault though, spoke to me when she thought he really was trying.
en: ...Shelly is sweet to a fault though, spoke to me when she thought he really was trying.
ja: ……でもシェリーは優しすぎるくらいで、あの人が本気だと思ったら、あたしに話しかけてきたの。

key: So I've been spending more time with him.
en: So I've been spending more time with him.
ja: それであの人と過ごす時間が増えたのよ。

key: But you can hardly blame me for teasing him, can you?
en: But you can hardly blame me for teasing him, can you?
ja: でもからかいたくなるのも仕方ないでしょ?

key: And he was so excited when I convinced him to first wear the cat ears because we matched...
en: And he was so excited when I convinced him to first wear the cat ears because we matched...
ja: 最初におそろいだからって猫耳を付けさせた時、あの人すごく喜んでたし……

key: Well, it's our thing now, I suppose.
en: Well, it's our thing now, I suppose.
ja: まあ、今じゃあたしたちの恒例行事ね。

key: TAKA: I'm glad you two have managed to make peace.
en: TAKA: I'm glad you two have managed to make peace.
ja: タカ: 二人が仲直りできて良かった。

key: Ten years really is a long time.
en: Ten years really is a long time.
ja: 十年って本当に長い時間だね。

key: Lots of people have spoken about what a good influence Shelly is, too...
en: Lots of people have spoken about what a good influence Shelly is, too...
ja: シェリーがいい影響を与えたって話も、色んな人から聞いたし……

key: ELIAS: Certainly.
en: ELIAS: Certainly.
ja: イライアス: 確かに。

key: ELIAS: Shelly has done a fine job.
en: ELIAS: Shelly has done a fine job.
ja: イライアス: シェリーはよくやってくれている。

key: But she can hardly take all the credit, she has been supported by a brilliant Elite Four.
en: But she can hardly take all the credit, she has been supported by a brilliant Elite Four.
ja: だが彼女一人の手柄というわけにもいくまい、優秀な四天王に支えられているのだからな。

key: Ah, but I forget myself--
en: Ah, but I forget myself--
ja: ああ、失念していた――

key: They were out of tea, I'm afraid.
en: They were out of tea, I'm afraid.
ja: お茶は切れていたよ、残念ながら。

key: Apparently somebody drank the entire stock to wash down the taste of a bad brownie?
en: Apparently somebody drank the entire stock to wash down the taste of a bad brownie?
ja: どうやら誰かが、まずいブラウニーの味を流し込むために全部飲んでしまったようだ。

key: TAKA: Ah, no worries about it, then...
en: TAKA: Ah, no worries about it, then...
ja: タカ: あ、それは全然大丈夫だよ……

key: A brilliant Elite Four, though?
en: A brilliant Elite Four, though?
ja: ところで、優秀な四天王って?

key: Does that mean you still have the job even after this long?
en: Does that mean you still have the job even after this long?
ja: それって、こんなに経った今でもまだその仕事続けてるってこと?

key: LUNA: No, he's just trying to be nice.
en: LUNA: No, he's just trying to be nice.
ja: ルナ: いいえ、父さんはただ優しくしようとしてるだけよ。

key: Iolia Valley is beautiful to battle in, certainly, but I must admit...
en: Iolia Valley is beautiful to battle in, certainly, but I must admit...
ja: イオリアバレーはバトルにはとても美しい場所ではあるけれど、正直に言うと……

key: I always admired the complex and elaborate rooms members of the Elite Four had at the league.
en: I always admired the complex and elaborate rooms members of the Elite Four had at the league.
ja: リーグの四天王が持つ、あの複雑で凝った部屋にはずっと憧れてたの。

key: And, as my father and I spent more time together...?
en: And, as my father and I spent more time together...?
ja: それに、父さんと過ごす時間が増えるにつれて……?

key: Well, I had one of the region's most accomplished trainers to spar with.
en: Well, I had one of the region's most accomplished trainers to spar with.
ja: まあ、この地方屈指の名トレーナーと練習試合できたのよ。

key: Is it any wonder I rose through the ranks?
en: Is it any wonder I rose through the ranks?
ja: そりゃ実力も上がるでしょ?

key: I am hardly the first to inherit a position in the League from her parent.
en: I am hardly the first to inherit a position in the League from her parent.
ja: 親からリーグの地位を受け継いだの、あたしが最初ってわけでもないしね。

key: TAKA: Oh, wow...
en: TAKA: Oh, wow...
ja: タカ: へえ、すごい……

key: Congratulations, Luna!
en: Congratulations, Luna!
ja: おめでとう、ルナ!

key: That's really cool.
en: That's really cool.
ja: それってすごく格好いいね。

key: Do you enjoy it?
en: Do you enjoy it?
ja: 楽しんでる?

key: LUNA: I must say, I do.
en: LUNA: I must say, I do.
ja: ルナ: そうね、楽しんでるわ。

key: Battling is fun, and being in the League allows me to tell a story as I do.
en: Battling is fun, and being in the League allows me to tell a story as I do.
ja: バトルは楽しいし、リーグにいることで物語を紡ぐこともできるの。

key: ELIAS: And somehow, she finds time to do so much more on top of an already demanding job!
en: ELIAS: And somehow, she finds time to do so much more on top of an already demanding job!
ja: イライアス: しかもこれだけ大変な仕事の傍らで、あれこれこなす時間まで見つけるのだからな!

key: LUNA: You never let my praises go unsung, do you father?
en: LUNA: You never let my praises go unsung, do you father?
ja: ルナ: あたしのことを褒めずにはいられないのね、父さん?

key: Yes, well... Shelly has taken a great interest in the history and culture of Reborn, wanting to ensure we don't lose sight of our past.
en: Yes, well... Shelly has taken a great interest in the history and culture of Reborn, wanting to ensure we don't lose sight of our past.
ja: ああ、そうだ……シェリーはリボーンの歴史と文化にとても関心を持っていてね、私たちの過去を見失わないようにしたいのだそうだ。

key: Thanks to father, I have access to much of the teachings and other documents from long ago.
en: Thanks to father, I have access to much of the teachings and other documents from long ago.
ja: 父さんのおかげで、あたしは昔の教えや文書の多くを手に入れられたの。

key: I do love storybooks, and you can find many gems of truth and wisdom within them.
en: I do love storybooks, and you can find many gems of truth and wisdom within them.
ja: 物語の本が大好きで、その中には真実と知恵の宝石がたくさん見つかるものよ。

key: But sometimes history can be a compelling storybook on its own, no?
en: But sometimes history can be a compelling storybook on its own, no?
ja: でも時には歴史そのものが、それ自体で魅力的な物語になることもあるわよね?

key: As Shelly has been cataloguing and recording and sharing much of the region's history and culture,
en: As Shelly has been cataloguing and recording and sharing much of the region's history and culture,
ja: シェリーがこの地方の歴史と文化の多くを記録し、分かち合ってくれているから、

key: I've been helping her by providing context, or personal notes,
en: I've been helping her by providing context, or personal notes,
ja: あたしは背景や個人的な記録を提供する形で手伝ってるの、

key: Things that you'd only really find in journals and records from my family or yours.
en: Things that you'd only really find in journals and records from my family or yours.
ja: あたしの家やあなたの家の日記や記録にしか残っていないようなことをね。

key: TAKA: That's... brilliant.
en: TAKA: That's... brilliant.
ja: タカ: それは……素晴らしいね。

key: There was a lot of our families' teachings I could never stand.
en: There was a lot of our families' teachings I could never stand.
ja: 僕たちの家の教えって、耐えられないと思うところもたくさんあったし。

key: But... my father was only one man, and one with many burdens and flaws.
en: But... my father was only one man, and one with many burdens and flaws.
ja: でも……父さんはただの一人の人間で、たくさんの重荷や欠点も抱えてたんだ。

key: I get that now, especially after meeting...
en: I get that now, especially after meeting...
ja: 今はそれが分かるよ、特に……会ってから。

key: Well, Celebi helped me see that perhaps there's still some good in our old traditions.
en: Well, Celebi helped me see that perhaps there's still some good in our old traditions.
ja: まあ、セレビィのおかげで、僕らの古い伝統にもまだいいところが残ってるのかもって思えるようになったんだ。

key: LUNA: Precisely.
en: LUNA: Precisely.
ja: ルナ: その通り。

key: And even where there were mistakes, it's good to know what they were and how we made them.
en: And even where there were mistakes, it's good to know what they were and how we made them.
ja: それに過ちがあった場所でも、それが何で、どうして起きたのか知っておくのはいいことよ。

key: ELIAS: It's never the path I saw our teachings taking, but...
en: ELIAS: It's never the path I saw our teachings taking, but...
ja: イライアス: 私たちの教えがこんな道をたどるとは思っていなかったが……

key: This is a newer, happier time.
en: This is a newer, happier time.
ja: これは新しく、より幸せな時代だ。

key: And I think I've gotten old enough to know I'm a little too old to be deciding what's best anymore.
en: And I think I've gotten old enough to know I'm a little too old to be deciding what's best anymore.
ja: そして、何が最善かを決めるには自分がもう歳を取りすぎていると分かる程度には、私も年を重ねたのだと思う。

key: I'm sure young people like the two of you, like Luna here, like Shelly...
en: I'm sure young people like the two of you, like Luna here, like Shelly...
ja: お前たち二人のような、そこのルナのような、シェリーのような若者たちが……

key: Will lead us to great things.
en: Will lead us to great things.
ja: きっと素晴らしいものへと私たちを導いてくれるだろう。

key: And I can only apologize in advance that, back in your own time, it may take me longer than it should to realise this.
en: And I can only apologize in advance that, back in your own time, it may take me longer than it should to realise this.
ja: そしてお前の時代では、私がこれに気付くのに本来より時間がかかってしまうだろうことを、あらかじめわびておこう。

key: LUNA: I'm sure your own future will end up just as bright as it has for us.
en: LUNA: I'm sure your own future will end up just as bright as it has for us.
ja: ルナ: あなたの未来も、あたしたちのように明るいものになるはずよ。

key: ...I'm glad you're well, Taka.
en: ...I'm glad you're well, Taka.
ja: ……元気そうで良かったわ、タカ。

key: TAKA: I'm glad you're well too, Luna.
en: TAKA: I'm glad you're well too, Luna.
ja: タカ: 君も元気そうで良かった、ルナ。

key: ELIAS: I see...
en: ELIAS: I see...
ja: イライアス: なるほど……

key: And those are... headphones?
en: And those are... headphones?
ja: それは……ヘッドホンかな?

key: LUNA: Yes, that's right, with cat ears on them.
en: LUNA: Yes, that's right, with cat ears on them.
ja: ルナ: ええ、そうよ、猫耳付きのね。

key: I thought they were cute.
en: I thought they were cute.
ja: 可愛いと思ったの。

key: The maid look didn't feel right after my family screwed up so bad that everyone I was supposed to serve died.
en: The maid look didn't feel right after my family screwed up so bad that everyone I was supposed to serve died.
ja: メイドの格好は、仕えるべき人たち全員を家族の失敗で死なせてしまった後じゃ、しっくりこなかったから。

key: LUNA: Oh, \PN! I didn't see you there!
en: LUNA: Oh, \PN! I didn't see you there!
ja: ルナ: あら、\PN! そこにいるの気付かなかったわ!

key: Welcome back, so lovely to see you.
en: Welcome back, so lovely to see you.
ja: おかえりなさい、会えて本当にうれしい。

key: Shelly has always said you would come back, but it's wonderful to see it happened.
en: Shelly has always said you would come back, but it's wonderful to see it happened.
ja: シェリーはいつも、あなたは戻ってくるって言ってたけど、実際そうなってうれしいわ。

key: ELIAS: Luna, I...
en: ELIAS: Luna, I...
ja: イライアス: ルナ、私は……

key: LUNA: Yes?
en: LUNA: Yes?
ja: ルナ: 何?

key: LUNA: Did you have something to say?
en: LUNA: Did you have something to say?
ja: ルナ: 何か言いたいことでもあった?

key: ELIAS: ...No.
en: ELIAS: ...No.
ja: イライアス: ……いや、何でもない。

key: My apologies for interrupting.
en: My apologies for interrupting.
ja: 邪魔をしてすまなかった。

key: You... mentioned Shelly?
en: You... mentioned Shelly?
ja: お前……シェリーのことを言っていたな?

key: Have you been spending time with her?
en: Have you been spending time with her?
ja: 彼女と一緒に過ごす時間があるのか?

key: LUNA: Ah, of course, you don't know.
en: LUNA: Ah, of course, you don't know.
ja: ルナ: ああ、そうか、知らないのね。

key: I am one of Reborn's Elite Four.
en: I am one of Reborn's Elite Four.
ja: あたしはリボーンの四天王の一人よ。

key: Naturally, this means I work a lot with the Champion.
en: Naturally, this means I work a lot with the Champion.
ja: 当然、チャンピオンとも一緒に仕事することが多いの。

key: Not to mention, I've been helping her with her project to better document the region's history,
en: Not to mention, I've been helping her with her project to better document the region's history,
ja: それに、この地方の歴史をもっとしっかり記録するプロジェクトを手伝ってるし、

key: And uncover much about its culture that has been lost.
en: And uncover much about its culture that has been lost.
ja: 失われた文化の多くを掘り起こす手伝いもしてるわ。

key: Thankfully, after your disappearance I found much of the family's old things, which has helped her hugely.
en: Thankfully, after your disappearance I found much of the family's old things, which has helped her hugely.
ja: ありがたいことに、あなたが消えた後、家に残ってた古いものをたくさん見つけたの、それがシェリーにすごく役立ったのよ。

key: ELIAS: Elite Four?
en: ELIAS: Elite Four?
ja: イライアス: 四天王か?

key: And teaching others about our past...
en: And teaching others about our past...
ja: それに、私たちの過去を人々に教えていると……

key: That's... lovely to hear, truly.
en: That's... lovely to hear, truly.
ja: それは……本当にうれしい話だ。

key: LUNA: I only hope I can do a better job than the last person that tried to do both those things.
en: LUNA: I only hope I can do a better job than the last person that tried to do both those things.
ja: ルナ: あたしがすることになった二つの役目、前にそれをやろうとした人よりうまくやれればいいけど。

key: I hear he made quite the mess of it.
en: I hear he made quite the mess of it.
ja: その人、かなり酷い有様だったって聞くもの。

key: LUNA: Now, I'm sure you all have many people you would love to say "Hello" to.
en: LUNA: Now, I'm sure you all have many people you would love to say "Hello" to.
ja: ルナ: さて、みんな挨拶したい人が他にもたくさんいるはずよね。

key: And best of luck in your own time, \PN.
en: And best of luck in your own time, \PN.
ja: あなたの時代でも頑張ってね、\PN。

key: If you ever need to recruit more members of the Elite Four, do give your favorite Dark Leader a thought!
en: If you ever need to recruit more members of the Elite Four, do give your favorite Dark Leader a thought!
ja: もし四天王のメンバーをもっと募集する必要があったら、お気に入りの悪タイプリーダーのことも思い出してね!

key: LUNA: Did you know that Taka and I grew up together?
en: LUNA: Did you know that Taka and I grew up together?
ja: ルナ: タカとあたしが一緒に育ったって知ってた?

key: Just as my father served his, I was meant to serve him.
en: Just as my father served his, I was meant to serve him.
ja: 父さんが父さんの父さんに仕えたように、あたしもタカに仕えるはずだったの。

key: That was why I did the whole maid thing, you know.
en: That was why I did the whole maid thing, you know.
ja: だからメイドの格好をしてたのよ。

key: Neither of us could stand our fathers, but I still believed that was my duty.
en: Neither of us could stand our fathers, but I still believed that was my duty.
ja: お互い自分の父親には耐えられなかったけど、それでもそれが自分の義務だと思ってたの。

key: Taka never wanted that though, and it took me far too long to see it.
en: Taka never wanted that though, and it took me far too long to see it.
ja: でもタカはそんなの望んでなかったし、それに気付くのにあたし、時間がかかりすぎたわ。

key: ...It took me 10 years to make the same strides that he did, but here we are now.
en: ...It took me 10 years to make the same strides that he did, but here we are now.
ja: ……あの人が成し遂げたのと同じ歩みを、あたしがするのに十年かかったけど、今こうしてここにいる。

key: Take care of him back in your time.
en: Take care of him back in your time.
ja: あなたの時代でも、彼のこと大事にしてあげて。

key: He deserves a break after...
en: He deserves a break after...
ja: 色々あった後だもの、休む資格があるわ……

key: Everything.
en: Everything.
ja: 全部含めて。

key: Shelly, too.
en: Shelly, too.
ja: シェリーもね。

key: She'll grow into a brilliant young woman, but I know 10 years ago she'd only just started to get confident.
en: She'll grow into a brilliant young woman, but I know 10 years ago she'd only just started to get confident.
ja: あの子はきっと素晴らしい女性に育つけど、十年前はまだ自信を持ち始めたばかりだったって分かってるから。

key: On everyone, really.
en: On everyone, really.
ja: 本当は、みんなのことよ。

key: But I trust you to keep an eye on them.
en: But I trust you to keep an eye on them.
ja: でもあなたなら、みんなをちゃんと見守ってくれると信じてる。

key: I can't imagine people will have a hard time growing into their best selves with you around.
en: I can't imagine people will have a hard time growing into their best selves with you around.
ja: あなたがいれば、みんな自分の一番いいところを伸ばすのに苦労はしないと思うわ。

key: LUNA: I apologize if that was... uncomfortable for you.
en: LUNA: I apologize if that was... uncomfortable for you.
ja: ルナ: もし今のが……あなたを不快にさせたなら謝るわ。

key: I'm older and wiser now, I'm in the Elite Four.
en: I'm older and wiser now, I'm in the Elite Four.
ja: あたしはもう大人になったし、四天王でもあるし。

key: I should know better.
en: I should know better.
ja: もっと分別を持たなきゃね。

key: I've always known he'd show up again eventually, though.
en: I've always known he'd show up again eventually, though.
ja: でも、あの人がいつか戻ってくるって、あたしはずっと分かってた。

key: Shelly said you two would be fine, and I trust her.
en: Shelly said you two would be fine, and I trust her.
ja: シェリーは二人とも大丈夫だって言ってたし、あの子のことは信じてるから。

key: I just...
en: I just...
ja: ボク ただ……

key: Maybe if he'd still been around, I could have forgiven him over time.
en: Maybe if he'd still been around, I could have forgiven him over time.
ja: もしあの人がずっとそばにいてくれてたら、時間をかけて許せたかもしれない。

key: Or maybe if I'd thought he was gone for good, I could've done the same.
en: Or maybe if I'd thought he was gone for good, I could've done the same.
ja: もしくは、あの人が完全にいなくなったって思えてたら、それでも同じように許せたかもしれない。

key: But knowing he'd eventually come back...
en: But knowing he'd eventually come back...
ja: でもいつか戻ってくるって分かってて……

key: I held onto how angry I was at him.
en: I held onto how angry I was at him.
ja: あたしはずっと、あの人への怒りを抱え続けてたの。

key: Might I ask for a selfish favor?
en: Might I ask for a selfish favor?
ja: わがままなお願いを一つしてもいい?

key: Back in your own time...
en: Back in your own time...
ja: あなたの時代でも……

key: Make sure he doesn't run from his past mistakes.
en: Make sure he doesn't run from his past mistakes.
ja: あの人が過去の過ちから逃げないようにさせて。

key: From me.
en: From me.
ja: あたしから、っていうことも。

key: I would prefer him to face the matter head on.
en: I would prefer him to face the matter head on.
ja: あの人にはきちんと向き合ってほしいの。

key: Because I truly hope that even if I cannot,
en: Because I truly hope that even if I cannot,
ja: だって心から願ってるから、たとえあたしにはできなくても、

key: The Luna of your time can finally let go of all these bad feelings.
en: The Luna of your time can finally let go of all these bad feelings.
ja: あなたの時代のルナが、こういう悪い感情を最後には手放せるようにって。

key: ELIAS: Elite Four.
en: ELIAS: Elite Four.
ja: イライアス: 四天王、か。

key: I'm sure if he had been a little younger, my father would have been a member of Reborn's when the league started.
en: I'm sure if he had been a little younger, my father would have been a member of Reborn's when the league started.
ja: もし父がもう少し若ければ、リーグができた時に彼もリボーンの四天王の一員になっていたに違いない。

key: He was fearsome in a battle.
en: He was fearsome in a battle.
ja: バトルでは実に恐ろしい人だった。

key: And I like to think I was rather good too, although I'm rather too old to be throwing Pokéballs these days.
en: And I like to think I was rather good too, although I'm rather too old to be throwing Pokéballs these days.
ja: 私もなかなかのものだったと自負しているが、最近ではモンスターボールを投げるには少々歳を取りすぎたようだ。

key: And now my daughter fills that role too.
en: And now my daughter fills that role too.
ja: そして今、私の娘がその役目を担っている。

key: I spent so long trying to make her follow family traditions.
en: I spent so long trying to make her follow family traditions.
ja: 私は長い間、あの子に家族の伝統を継がせようとしてきた。

key: And yet here she's made one I never considered.
en: And yet here she's made one I never considered.
ja: それなのに、あの子はここで私が考えもしなかった伝統を新しく作り上げたのだ。

key: Truly, this is the wonder of the younger generation.
en: Truly, this is the wonder of the younger generation.
ja: 実に、これが若い世代の驚異というものだろう。

key: I can only imagine the brilliant things in store for Taka's future too.
en: I can only imagine the brilliant things in store for Taka's future too.
ja: タカの未来にも、素晴らしいことが待っているのだろうと想像するばかりだ。

key: TAKA: Elite Four...
en: TAKA: Elite Four...
ja: タカ: 四天王か……

key: You know, when we were young, Luna always said she wanted to be nothing like her dad.
en: You know, when we were young, Luna always said she wanted to be nothing like her dad.
ja: そういえば、小さい頃、ルナはいつも父親には絶対似たくないって言ってたっけ。

key: And I could hardly blame her.
en: And I could hardly blame her.
ja: それも当然だと思ってたよ。

key: We had that in common.
en: We had that in common.
ja: そこは僕らの共通点だったんだ。

key: It's funny how things turn out.
en: It's funny how things turn out.
ja: 物事ってどう転ぶか分からないもんだね。

key: I guess ten years of peace are pretty good conditions for people to better themselves, though?
en: I guess ten years of peace are pretty good conditions for people to better themselves, though?
ja: 平和な十年って、人が自分を磨くにはいい条件なのかもね?

key: I wonder what ways I'll end up like my father?
en: I wonder what ways I'll end up like my father?
ja: 僕はどんな形で父さんに似ていくんだろう?

key: ...I hope I end up more like Taube, though.
en: ...I hope I end up more like Taube, though.
ja: ……できればタウベにもっと似ればいいんだけど。

key: ELIAS: ...My apologies my Lord, I...
en: ELIAS: ...My apologies my Lord, I...
ja: イライアス: ……申し訳ありません我が主、私は……

key: I will find you as you greet other people, of course, don't worry about me.
en: I will find you as you greet other people, of course, don't worry about me.
ja: あなたが他の人々に挨拶している間、私の方から探しに行きます、私のことは気にしないでください。

key: I think I just need some time to think of the right words to say.
en: I think I just need some time to think of the right words to say.
ja: ふさわしい言葉を考えるのに、少し時間が必要なだけですから。

key: VICTORIA: Yes it's...
en: VICTORIA: Yes it's...
ja: ヴィクトリア: ええ、それは……

key: Uh...
en: Uh...
ja: えっと……

key: Definitely a bold flavor profile you went for.
en: Definitely a bold flavor profile you went for.
ja: 確かに大胆な味の方向性ではあるわね。

key: I think it's really--
en: I think it's really--
ja: これは本当に――

key: VICTORIA: \PN! Thank goodness you're here!
en: VICTORIA: \PN! Thank goodness you're here!
ja: ヴィクトリア: \PN! 良かった、来てくれたのね!

key: That is, ah, thank goodness you've finally returned.
en: That is, ah, thank goodness you've finally returned.
ja: じゃなくて、その、ついに戻ってきてくれて良かった。

key: It's so nice to see you again!
en: It's so nice to see you again!
ja: また会えてすごくうれしいわ!

key: And you too, Taka!
en: And you too, Taka!
ja: タカもね!

key: TAKA: Thanks, it's nice to see that everyone's doing really well despite...
en: TAKA: Thanks, it's nice to see that everyone's doing really well despite...
ja: タカ: ありがとう、みんな本当に元気そうで良かったよ、色々あった割に……

key: VICTORIA: It helps that we've had a decade to figure out what we're doing with our lives.
en: VICTORIA: It helps that we've had a decade to figure out what we're doing with our lives.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 十年もあれば、自分の人生をどう生きるか見つけるには十分だもの。

key: I'm sure you'll be the same after a decade.
en: I'm sure you'll be the same after a decade.
ja: あなたも十年経てば同じようになるはずよ。

key: TAKA: ...I sure hope so.
en: TAKA: ...I sure hope so.
ja: タカ: ……そうだといいけど。

key: SAPHIRA: Taka.
en: SAPHIRA: Taka.
ja: サファイラ: タカ。

key: TAKA: Uh... Y-yeah?
en: TAKA: Uh... Y-yeah?
ja: タカ: えっと……う、うん?

key: SAPHIRA: You were raised by shitty people, and did shitty things.
en: SAPHIRA: You were raised by shitty people, and did shitty things.
ja: サファイラ: あんたはろくでもない人たちに育てられて、ろくでもないこともした。

key: Turn out better than them.
en: Turn out better than them.
ja: その人たちよりましな人間になりなさい。

key: Be better than them.
en: Be better than them.
ja: その人たちよりいい人間になりなさい。

key: That's how you make up for your part in all that.
en: That's how you make up for your part in all that.
ja: それがそのことへの償い方よ。

key: I'm working on it...?
en: I'm working on it...?
ja: 今、頑張ってるところ……?

key: SAPHIRA: Good.
en: SAPHIRA: Good.
ja: サファイラ: よし。

key: Never stop working on it.
en: Never stop working on it.
ja: その努力、絶対に止めないで。

key: VICTORIA: You're out here with the tough love, Saphira.
en: VICTORIA: You're out here with the tough love, Saphira.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 相変わらず厳しい愛情を見せるのね、サファイラ。

key: Here I thought the kids had softened you up a bit.
en: Here I thought the kids had softened you up a bit.
ja: 子供たちに少しは丸くなったと思ってたのに。

key: Oh, I should explain--
en: Oh, I should explain--
ja: ああ、説明しないとね――

key: Saphira works up in Labradorra, setting up homes for vulnerable young people.
en: Saphira works up in Labradorra, setting up homes for vulnerable young people.
ja: サファイラはラブラドーラで、居場所のない若者たちのための家を作る仕事をしているの。

key: ELIAS: Indeed, it is truly wonderful that My Lord and I ha--
en: ELIAS: Indeed, it is truly wonderful that My Lord and I ha--
ja: イライアス: 確かに、我が主と私が実に素晴らし――

key: SAPHIRA: No.
en: SAPHIRA: No.
ja: サファイラ: だめだ

key: SAPHIRA: Absolutely not.
en: SAPHIRA: Absolutely not.
ja: サファイラ: 絶対だめ。

key: SAPHIRA: Leave.
en: SAPHIRA: Leave.
ja: サファイラ: 出てって。

key: SAPHIRA: \PN. It's nice to see you again.
en: SAPHIRA: \PN. It's nice to see you again.
ja: サファイラ: \PN。また会えてうれしいわ。

key: None of this would have been possible without you.
en: None of this would have been possible without you.
ja: あんたがいなかったら、これは何一つ実現しなかった。

key: VICTORIA: Saphira works up in Labradorra, setting up homes for vulnerable young people.
en: VICTORIA: Saphira works up in Labradorra, setting up homes for vulnerable young people.
ja: ヴィクトリア: サファイラはラブラドーラで、居場所のない若者たちのための家を作る仕事をしているの。

key: Those who have escaped or survived bad situations, and need somewhere safe and stable.
en: Those who have escaped or survived bad situations, and need somewhere safe and stable.
ja: 悪い状況から逃げてきたり、生き延びたりした子たちで、安全で安定した居場所が必要な子たちよ。

key: SAPHIRA: Too many people dismiss the needs of 'runaways' and 'strays'.
en: SAPHIRA: Too many people dismiss the needs of 'runaways' and 'strays'.
ja: サファイラ: 「家出人」とか「はぐれ者」の必要としてるものを軽く見る人が多すぎる。

key: But these kids are fighters. They're strong.
en: But these kids are fighters. They're strong.
ja: でもこの子たちは戦う子たちなの。強いのよ。

key: ...Kids shouldn't NEED to be strong.
en: ...Kids shouldn't NEED to be strong.
ja: ……本当は、子供が強くなる「必要」なんてあっちゃいけないのに。

key: TAKA: Yeah...
en: TAKA: Yeah...
ja: タカ: そうだね……

key: They really shouldn't.
en: They really shouldn't.
ja: 本当にそうあってほしくない。

key: Being a kid should just be...
en: Being a kid should just be...
ja: 子供でいるってことは、ただ……

key: Nice?
en: Nice?
ja: 楽しいことであってほしいよね?

key: VICTORIA: I may be very busy with Apophyll, but I understand every young person has different needs.
en: VICTORIA: I may be very busy with Apophyll, but I understand every young person has different needs.
ja: ヴィクトリア: アポフィルの仕事で忙しいけど、若者それぞれに違う必要があることは分かってるつもり。

key: And in some cases the Academy can offer exactly the kind of support and help they need.
en: And in some cases the Academy can offer exactly the kind of support and help they need.
ja: 場合によっては、アカデミーがその子に必要な種類の支援や助けをぴったり提供できることもあるの。

key: So Saphira and I are in regular contact about how best to help each other, and those we take care of.
en: So Saphira and I are in regular contact about how best to help each other, and those we take care of.
ja: だからサファイラとあたしは、お互いをどう助け合うか、それぞれが世話してる子たちをどう助けるか、いつも連絡を取り合ってるのよ。

key: SAPHIRA: It's hard to say my life has calmed down much.
en: SAPHIRA: It's hard to say my life has calmed down much.
ja: サファイラ: あたしの生活が落ち着いたとは言いがたいわね。

key: Managing basically a whole city and being there to help the kids when they need it...
en: Managing basically a whole city and being there to help the kids when they need it...
ja: ほぼ丸ごと一つの街を管理しつつ、子供たちが必要な時にはそばにいてやって……

key: It's a different kind of crazy to ten years ago, but still crazy.
en: It's a different kind of crazy to ten years ago, but still crazy.
ja: 十年前とはまた違う種類のめちゃくちゃさだけど、それでもめちゃくちゃなことに変わりはない。

key: But these days I get some moments to myself.
en: But these days I get some moments to myself.
ja: でも最近は自分の時間も少し取れるようになったの。

key: Time to relax.
en: Time to relax.
ja: くつろぐ時間がね。

key: I picked up baking!
en: I picked up baking!
ja: お菓子作りを始めたのよ!

key: It has the advantage of being productive, while also enforcing periods of time to relax in.
en: It has the advantage of being productive, while also enforcing periods of time to relax in.
ja: 生産的でありながら、ちゃんとくつろぐ時間を強制的に作れる、いいところもあるし。

key: There's time to take it slow and appreciate the present.
en: There's time to take it slow and appreciate the present.
ja: ゆっくり進めて、今この瞬間を味わう時間もあるの。

key: And the kids in Labradorra are sweet, always turning me down when I make them something,
en: And the kids in Labradorra are sweet, always turning me down when I make them something,
ja: それにラブラドーラの子たちは優しくて、何か作ってあげようとすると、いつも遠慮するの、

key: Saying I already do so much for them, they can't take more.
en: Saying I already do so much for them, they can't take more.
ja: もう十分色々やってもらってるから、これ以上は受け取れないって言って。

key: So I brought some brownies I made with me. If you want one, they're at the café.
en: So I brought some brownies I made with me. If you want one, they're at the café.
ja: だから作ったブラウニーを持ってきたの。食べたければカフェにあるわ。

key: TAKA: Oh, right, I saw those when I was over there.
en: TAKA: Oh, right, I saw those when I was over there.
ja: タカ: ああ、そういえば、さっきあっちで見たよ。

key: You definitely went for a...
en: You definitely went for a...
ja: なんていうか、確実に……

key: Unique? Shape...
en: Unique? Shape...
ja: 独特な? 形だったね……

key: VICTORIA: Yeah, I actually just had one...
en: VICTORIA: Yeah, I actually just had one...
ja: ヴィクトリア: ええ、実はさっき一つ食べたところなの……

key: VICTORIA: Yes, I just had one.
en: VICTORIA: Yes, I just had one.
ja: ヴィクトリア: そうね、さっき一つ食べたところ。

key: I was telling Saphira how... creative her flavor combinations are.
en: I was telling Saphira how... creative her flavor combinations are.
ja: サファイラに、味の組み合わせがすごく……独創的だねって言ってたところなの。

key: But you're right, the look is equally... creative.
en: But you're right, the look is equally... creative.
ja: でもあなたの言う通り、見た目も同じくらい……独創的よね。

key: SAPHIRA: Well, do let me know how they are if you try one, \PN.
en: SAPHIRA: Well, do let me know how they are if you try one, \PN.
ja: サファイラ: まあ、食べてみたら感想教えてね、\PN。

key: Or you, Taka.
en: Or you, Taka.
ja: タカもね。

key: Most people ate before they came, so they didn't want one.
en: Most people ate before they came, so they didn't want one.
ja: ほとんどの人は来る前に食べてきたから、いらないって言ってたのよ。

key: I'll let you get back to it, though.
en: I'll let you get back to it, though.
ja: じゃあ、続けてもらってて構わないわ。

key: VICTORIA: Yeah, it was really lovely to see you.
en: VICTORIA: Yeah, it was really lovely to see you.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ええ、本当に会えてうれしかった。

key: I'm really happy you're both safe.
